descriptionPlain:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts 
Who You Are: 
Highlevel is looking for a detail-oriented and people-first Affiliate Payment Ops Specialist II.  Reporting to the Accounts Payable Manager, you'll be the operational backbone of our referral and endorsements programs — making sure affiliates and endorsers are paid accurately, records are maintained meticulously, and every partner feels supported. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who is eager to develop expertise in SaaS partnerships, financial operations, and affiliate marketing.

Who You Are: 

Highlevel is looking for a detail-oriented and people-first Affiliate Payment Ops Specialist II.  Reporting to the Accounts Payable Manager, you'll be the operational backbone of our referral and endorsements programs — making sure affiliates and endorsers are paid accurately, records are maintained meticulously, and every partner feels supported. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who is eager to develop expertise in SaaS partnerships, financial operations, and affiliate marketing.

lists.content:
Affiliates Program

  • Develop a thorough working knowledge of the commissions structure and apply it consistently across all affiliate activity

  • Monitor and maintain affiliate records within the referral program platform, including upgrade tier tracking, referral link assignments, and account tagging

  • Validate commission calculations on a regular basis to for accuracy before payouts are processed

  • Process weekly commission payouts in a timely and accurate manner, flagging discrepancies for resolution

  • Maintain organized affiliate payment and tax records in compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements

  • Prepare and issue year-end 1099 forms to applicable affiliates

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for affiliate inquiries, managing a high-volume inbox with professionalism, accuracy, and a consistent response standard

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Affiliate department, managing communications and manual requests, escalating complex cases as needed

  • Identify patterns in affiliate questions or issues and proactively surface process improvement opportunities to leadership

    • Endorsements Program

  • Administer endorsement payouts, confirming agreements are accurately reflected in payment records and disbursements are processed on schedule

  • Track and reconcile endorsement payment terms, deliverables, and payout milestones in coordination with relevant stakeholders

  • Directly enter and manage endorsement invoices in the AP system, securing comprehensive documentation and accurate coding to guarantee timely cross-departmental submission and absolute audit readiness

  • Collaborate with the accounting team to maintain and update the endorsements tracker, confirming accuracy and completeness for the marketing team's visibility

  • Serve as the operational link between the Marketing department and accounting on all endorsement-related payment activity

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

Experience/Education/Certifications Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required.

  • Minimum of 2 years in a front-facing role, preferably in Affiliate operations or Accounts Payable 

  • Hands-on experience with referral program tracking software, such as FirstPromoter

  • Experience with global payout platforms and methods 

  • General understanding of Accounts Payable processes, including vendor onboarding and tax documentation 

  • Experience with working with data in Excel and Google Sheets

  • A customer-first mindset with strong written and verbal communication skills

• Design, develop, and maintain API integrations between enterprise IT systems and financial/non-financial applications

  • Implement event-driven integrations using webhooks and APIs to enable real-time updates across systems

  • Perform data validation and reconciliation between systems (e.g., HRMS vs identity platforms)

• 4+ years of experience in software development, IT automation, or API integrations
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python or Java
  • Experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, and system integrations
  • Understanding of identity and access management (IAM) and user provisioning workflows
  • Experience with SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, HRMS tools, and collaboration tools
  • Familiarity with authentication protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML, API tokens)
  • IGA tool customization or Connector development experience

    Preferred Qualifications
  • Knowledge of IGA tools such as Okta and Tuebora
  • Experience with ITSM tools (e.g., Atomicwork, ServiceNow)
  • Exposure to integration platforms (Zapier, Workato, MuleSoft)
  • Knowledge of Google Admin APIs, Darwinbox APIs, Slack APIs
  • Understanding of ITGC, SOX controls, and access governance processes
  • Experience working in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Familiarity with automation scripting and event-driven workflows
  • Saviynt or Sailpoint ISC or Sailpoint IIQ development experience would be great fit

lists.content:
Why this role exists : 

As HighLevel continues to scale its product portfolio, we see a growing need for leaders who can connect Product, Finance, and GTM teams to drive revenue growth and strategic execution.

This role is being created to identify growth opportunities, align stakeholders, and lead high-impact initiatives across multiple products. We are looking for someone who can bridge strategy and execution—turning business goals into measurable outcomes and helping accelerate the next phase of growth.

Revenue Growth & Business Strategy 

  • Analyze revenue performance, product adoption, customer behavior, and monetisation opportunities across multiple product lines.

  • Partner with Product and Finance teams to identify growth opportunities and prioritise high-impact initiatives.

  • Develop business cases, growth plans, and strategic recommendations to improve revenue and adoption.

  • Drive planning processes and track progress against key business objectives.

    • Product & Growth Initiatives 

  • Build a deep understanding of HighLevel's products, customers, and revenue drivers.

  • Identify opportunities across new revenue streams , adoption and expansion.

  • Work closely with Product teams to shape and execute strategic initiatives that drive business impact.

    • Cross Functional Leadership 

  • Align Product, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams around common goals.

  • Drive clarity, accountability, and execution across complex initiatives.

  • Influence stakeholders and facilitate decision-making across multiple functions.

    • Strategic Execution 

  • Own high-priority initiatives from ideation through execution.

  • Establish operating rhythms, success metrics, and tracking mechanisms.

  • Monitor outcomes, identify risks, and course-correct when necessary.

  • Continuously improve planning, prioritization, and execution processes.

First 6 Months 

  • Develop a strong understanding of HighLevel's products, customers, and revenue drivers.

  • Build trusted relationships across Product, Finance, and GTM teams.

  • Identify and prioritize strategic growth opportunities.

  • Influence roadmap and business decisions through data-driven insights.

    • Within 12 Months 

  • Successfully drive measurable improvements in revenue, adoption, and business performance.

  • Lead strategic initiatives from concept to execution.

  • Become a trusted advisor to leadership on growth and business strategy.

  • Improve organizational alignment, planning quality, and execution effectiveness.

• 9–12 years of experience in Founder’s Office, Chief of Staff, Strategy & Operations, Product Strategy, Revenue Strategy, Growth, or Business Operations roles.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, monetization, pricing, adoption, retention, and growth metrics.

  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional initiatives across Product, Finance, GTM, and Leadership teams.

  • Demonstrated track record of translating strategy into execution and delivering measurable business outcomes.

  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and influencing without direct authority.

  • Hands-on with AI tools and modern productivity workflows.

  • Experience in high-growth SaaS, startup, or consulting-led environments is preferred.

    • Preferred Backgrounds

  • Founder’s Office or Chief of Staff in a high-growth startup.

  • Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, or Growth leadership roles.

  • Professionals  from Consulting background who have transitioned into operating roles.

  • Professionals with experience driving monetization, pricing, growth, or business transformation initiatives.

About the Role
We’re looking for a Benefits Operations Manager to serve as the agile "engine room" for the health, foundational care, and regulatory infrastructure of the People organization at HighLevel. Reporting directly to the Chief of Staff in the CPO’s Office, you will lead high-impact initiatives dedicated to translating strategic vision into disciplined, compliant execution.
This isn't a "check-the-box" administrative role; it is a senior individual contributor position designed for a technical compliance and benefits specialist who thrives on solving complex, cross-functional puzzles. As a seasoned professional, you possess specialized or advanced expertise and will work on assignments requiring considerable judgment and initiative, understanding the deep structural implications of your work and making independent recommendations for solutions.
The ideal candidate is obsessed with the internal customer experience, viewing every benefit option, leave policy, wellness program, and state-by-state approval framework through the lens of the employee and manager. You must be a master of "just enough" governance: providing the rigorous documentation and compliance needed for corporate security while designing systems that are fluid and seamless for our fast-paced, high-growth environment.
What You’ll Do
End-to-End Initiative Lifecycle Ownership
Drive Cross-Functional Delivery: Own the full lifecycle of high-visibility benefits, wellness, and compliance initiatives, from initial concept and framework chartering to final multi-state implementation and employee adoption.
Manage Team-Wide Sequencing: Partner with the Chief of Staff to prioritize the compliance and benefits collective backlog, ensuring resources are focused on high-priority regulatory and infrastructure needs.
Rapid Re-Scoping: Demonstrate the agility to shift program goals, wellness rollouts, and plan timelines mid-stream as business priorities or federal/state regulations evolve, without losing operational rigor.
Direct Application of Principles: Guide the development of new infrastructure and apply existing principles in resourceful and effective ways to navigate complex structural goals.
Customer-Obsessed Governance & Execution
Adopt a "Customer First" Mindset: Treat every benefits open enrollment, wellness program, and lifestyle perk as a product launch where the employees and managers are the end users.
Foundational Program Execution: Own the full administration of US health benefits and 401k plans, serving as the main point of contact for day-to-day vendor relationships, platform management, and system updates.
Leave & Care Management: Design, oversee, and optimize regional and global employee leave programs, ensuring an empathetic, smooth, and highly organized journey for employees taking time away.
Well-Being & Perks Optimization: Build out, launch, and manage modern employee perk architectures (such as remote-work stipends and lifestyle perks) alongside company-wide well-being initiatives (mental health weeks, wellness programs).
Geographic Compliance Navigation: Independently research, process, and track state-by-state hiring approvals and regional compliance parameters, partnering closely with Accounting, Finance, and Legal.
Design for Adoption: Proactively identify and remove "friction points" in benefits enrollment or compliance tracking to ensure a seamless experience for the organization.
Quality & Process Rigor: Maintain the absolute "source of truth" for all benefit records, compliance logs, and 401k updates, ensuring documentation is precise, accessible, and professional.
Agile Governance & Process Rigor
Establish "Just Enough" Governance: Build documentation standards and project rituals for compliance and leave tracking that provide maximum visibility with minimum "process tax" for managers.
Navigate Ambiguity with Grace: Understand and work on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Shift gears fluidly as business footprints expand across new states, maintaining operational momentum.
Clear & Empathetic Communication: Translate highly technical, complex compliance parameters, legal parameters, or benefit summary descriptions into concise, human-centric narratives for executive and all-company audiences.

Anticipate Resistance Points: Proactively identify potential roadblocks to employee benefits adoption or manager compliance, designing mitigation strategies that prioritize a positive employee experience.
Build High-Touch Enablement: Create intuitive leader toolkits, clear compliance FAQs, benefits summaries, and feedback loops that empower stakeholders to navigate health plans and leave parameters with minimal overhead.
Iterate Based on Feedback: Use plan utilization data, employee feedback, and real-time sentiment data to pivot perk configurations and wellness program designs, ensuring they solve actual user problems.
Identify Efficiency Opportunities: Proactively audit and identify opportunities to improve benefits administration process efficiency and compliance scalability as the enterprise grows.
What You’ll Bring
8+ Years of Experience: Leading complex, multi-workstream initiatives within US health benefits administration, 401k management, and employment compliance in high-growth, remote-first environments.
Advanced Wide-Ranging Expertise: In-depth professional knowledge and acumen regarding US health care infrastructure, ERISA rules, 401k fiduciary practices, and multi-state compliance.
Strategic Judgment: Proven ability to independently evaluate variable factors, select appropriate methods, and make definitive structural recommendations that align with departmental objectives.
Stakeholder Empathy & Influence: Proven ability to partner with and influence cross-functional groups (Legal, Finance, Accounting) by thoroughly understanding their unique constraints and shared risk goals.
Outcome Over Output: A track record of measuring success by plan utilization, employee stability, and compliance health rather than just basic execution.
High EQ & Discretion: Exceptional judgment and complete confidentiality when handling sensitive employee scenarios, including medical leaves, personal leaves, and health-related accommodation requests.
Why This Role Matters
At HighLevel, we move fast, but speed without structure leads to friction and risk. This role is the bridge between "what" we want to provide to support our team and "how" it actually gets executed sustainably and securely. By establishing agile governance, strict compliance, and process rigor across our benefits, perks, and wellness programs, you ensure that the People team’s operational foundation is sequenced correctly, resourced effectively, and delivered with excellence.
You matter because you protect our culture of Customer Obsession by securing our team's foundational well-being. By managing dependencies, auditing plans, and proactively mitigating regulatory risks, you prevent administrative fatigue and ensure that every benefit plan and wellness initiative feels like a true value-add to our employees. Ultimately, you are the architect of our operational backbone, enabling the CPO’s Office to scale with precision and driving measurable impact that keeps our talent—and our business—ahead of the curve.
 The salary range for this position is $108000 - $130000 annually.

descriptionBody:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
 
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
 
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
 
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
 

Who You Are

You are a highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable professional who enjoys supporting community programs and ensuring operations run smoothly behind the scenes.

You thrive in execution-focused environments, where you can coordinate logistics, follow structured processes, and support teams in delivering consistent experiences. You enjoy working with community members, maintaining organization across multiple workflows, and ensuring tasks are completed with accuracy and efficiency.

You are comfortable working within defined frameworks, supporting day-to-day program operations, and escalating issues when needed. You bring a collaborative mindset and are eager to learn and grow within a fast-paced environment.

About HighLevelHighLevel is building the platform that helps agencies and small businesses grow: marketing, sales, messaging, automation, payments, reputation, and customer management in one product suite. The product is broad, fast-moving, and used by customers who depend on speed, reliability, and clear workflows every day.
The Product Design team is entering a new stage. We are just under 30 people today, spanning product design, research, design systems, and content strategy, with another 12-16 hires expected as the business scales. We have strong momentum and a company-wide bias toward velocity. Now we need a design operating model that can keep pace with that velocity while raising the bar for clarity, craft, coordination, and launch readiness.
We are hiring our first Design Program Manager to help build that model.
About The RoleAs Design Program Manager, you will be the operating partner for Product Design. You will help the team mature an inconsistent and unruly design process into a clear, lightweight, repeatable system without slowing down the company's well-established ability to move quickly.
This is a foundational role embedded in the Product Design team. The Director of SDET is a pivotal role blending strong technical depth with strategic and people leadership. 

You will own the quality engineering vision for the organization, mentor the next generation of SDET managers and leads, and champion the adoption of AI-driven tools and practices to modernize how the organization builds, tests, and ships software.

-> Quality Strategy & Architecture:
  • Own the end-to-end quality engineering vision, strategy, and roadmap across multiple product lines or business units
  • Establish quality gates, release readiness criteria, and CI/CD processes
  • Drive a "shift-left, shift-right" quality culture — embedding testability into design reviews and using production observability to close the loop
  • Conduct architectural reviews across new and existing products to proactively surface scalability, reliability, and performance risks
  • Evaluate and select tooling, frameworks, and platforms (open-source and commercial) that scale automation across teams
    • -> AI Adoption:
  • Lead the org's AI adoption strategy for quality engineering — building or integrating AI/ML-based testing tools to improve coverage, productivity, and defect prediction
  • Continuously evaluate and leverage AI for all aspects of Quality Engineering ensuring quality strategy keeps pace with how product is built
    • -> Stakeholder & People Leadership:
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Security leadership to align quality goals with business and release objectives
  • Provide regular quality updates, metrics, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership
  • Define, set up, and monitor key quality and productivity metrics (KPIs/OKRs)
  • Lead succession planning and mentor SDET Managers and Leads to build the next layer of quality leadership

• 15+ years in software testing/quality engineering, including 5+ years in a Director or senior engineering leadership role
  • Deep expertise in test automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, RestAssured, etc.) and languages (Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript)
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness CI/CD), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
  • Hands-on experience building AI/ML-based testing tools that measurably improve coverage and productivity
  • Solid grounding in performance testing, security testing, and other non-functional quality attributes
  • Experience architecting test strategies for microservices, distributed systems, and mobile platforms

• Experience presenting AI or quality-transformation initiatives at conferences
  • Prior experience testing high-transaction SaaS platforms (CRM, Payments, Automation, Email, Fintech, or similar)
  • Experience building and testing AI products using Agentic AI, including evaluation frameworks
  • Contributions to open-source testing frameworks or published thought leadership on QE/AI trends

• Quality vision and strategic execution
  • Non-functional testing (performance, security, reliability) and continuous delivery
  • Operational discipline within a fast-paced, rapid release environment
  • Stakeholder management across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and business functions
  • Team building and mentorship
  • Data-driven reporting of quality and productivity metrics to executive stakeholders

About the Role:

What are we hiring for?
We're going to replace the inbox. All of it.
Gmail. Outlook. Front. Every single-channel and omnichannel inbox out there.
Conversations is the most-used surface in HighLevel — the page where our customers spend the majority of their day. Every SMS, email, WhatsApp, DM, and call lands here. It's where deals get closed, customers get answered, and businesses get run.
We want to make it the only inbox a business will ever need.
That's the bar. And you'll lead the team building it.

The Mission

Build the omnichannel inbox that every business in the world wishes they had — fast, reliable, intuitive, and deeply integrated with everything else our customers do.
You're not here to manage tickets. You're here to own the product surface that defines HighLevel — and lead the engineers who'll build it into the category winner.

lists.content:
• 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 2–3 years managing teams of 8+ engineers.

    • Hands-on technical depth — you can still review architecture, debug a production incident, and call out a bad design choice in a PR.

      • Excellent product judgment — proven track record of shipping products customers love, not just features that hit deadlines.

        • Experience leading teams that own a major product surface with high traffic, real-time requirements, and complex state.

          • Strong grasp of distributed systems and/or frontend systems at scale — ideally both.


            • Demonstrated ability to run ops cleanly — daily, sprintly, and quarterly — while keeping eyes on the long-term vision.

• A team of 10+ engineers — juniors to seniors — building the Conversations product end to end: inbox UI, real-time threads, multi-channel routing, search, automations, and the platform underneath it all.

    • A product surface used by millions of users daily, processing 68M+ messages/month and climbing to billions.

      • Frontend, backend, and platform work across:

        • Frontend: Vue.js (2/3), Vuex/Pinia, Module Federation, real-time UI at scale

          • Backend: Node.js (TypeScript), Go, event-driven pipelines, 50+ workloads, thousands of pods

            • Infra: GCP (GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks), Firestore, MongoDB, Redis, ElasticSearch, ClickHouse

              • The roadmap, the architecture, and the people decisions that determine whether we win this category.

On the product side:

  • Bring strong product judgment to every roadmap call — what to build, what to kill, what to polish.

    • Partner with Product and Design as a true peer — push back, prototype, and ship things that customers actually feel.

      • Obsess over the details: latency, layout stability, the way a thread loads on a flaky network, the way a notification lands at the right moment.

        • Own the vision — quarterly bets, where the product needs to be in 12 months, what wedge we drive next.

          • On the engineering side:

          • Be hands-on. Read PRs that matter. Get into the code when the stakes are high. Stay technical enough that your team trusts your calls.

            • Own engineering velocity, quality, and stability — three numbers you live and die by.

              • Architect for the next 10x: delivery guarantees, retry semantics, idempotency, real-time sync, omnichannel state.

                • Run clean ops — daily standups that don't waste time, sprints that ship, quarters that compound.

                  • On the people side:

                  • Build a high-performing team by putting the right people in the right seats.

                    • Regular 1:1s. Honest feedback. Real growth conversations. No surprises at performance review time.

                      • Hire smart. Coach harder. Move people up — or move them out — without flinching.

                        • Set a culture where engineers do their best work of their careers because of you, not in spite of you.

• The team is shipping fast and clean. Velocity is high, regressions are rare, and on-call is boring.

    • Customers tell us, "I don't need Gmail anymore." Then they tell their friends.

      • Your team is the one other teams want to join.

        • You've earned the trust of engineers, PMs, designers, and leadership — because you deliver.

Customers > Org > Team > Self.

That's the order. In that order. Always.

  • No blame games. Something broke? Fix it, learn from it, ship the post-mortem, move on.

    • Customer-first thinking, not ego-first. The right answer wins — even if it wasn't yours.

      • Strong opinions, weakly held. You'll change your mind when the data says so.

        • You don't wait for permission to lead. You see the gap, you close it.

• We're not corporate. We're not politics. We don't do fluff.

    • We don't do performance theater. We do performance.


      • We don't track hours. But when production breaks or a launch is on the line, we show up.

• Experience building inboxes, messaging, communication, or collaboration products.

    • Familiarity with our stack: Vue.js, Node.js, Go, GCP, Kubernetes, Firestore, MongoDB, ClickHouse, ElasticSearch.

      • You've shipped omnichannel or multi-channel systems (SMS, Email, WhatsApp, etc.) before.

        • You've taken a 0→1 product to scale — or rebuilt one mid-flight without breaking it.

  • Experience with scalable, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated success mentoring engineers and developing leaders.

  • People & Culture: Hire effectively, develop talent, set engineering standards, and foster a psychologically safe, high-impact culture.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Design, and other engineering teams to define and deliver new capabilities users love.

• Your team ships predictable, well-tested features that expand Custom Objects adoption and delight customers.
  • The Custom Objects platform scales smoothly with usage, automation, and data complexity.
  • Engineers feel empowered and supported, and you’re recognized as a leader people trust.
  • The platform becomes a foundation other teams build on, with clear APIs, documentation, and reliability guarantees.

About the Role: 
We are seeking a high-caliber Engineering Manager II to lead our Monetization Platform team. 
This team is the financial heartbeat of HighLevel, owning the entire billing and reselling architecture. Every transaction—from subscriptions and plans to usage-based charges and auto-recharges—flows through systems this team builds. You will manage the critical reselling and rebilling layer that allows our 2M+ businesses to mark up and resell services, ensuring a seamless financial experience for agencies and their clients.
 
The system processes 160M+ daily events and $4M worth of transactions, requiring extreme operational precision.This is the most high-consequence correctness domain in the company. The platform must be high-throughput, highly available, and demand zero tolerance for inconsistency. 
 
In this role, precision is paramount: a lost usage event is unbilled revenue, while a duplicated one undermines customer trust. You will also oversee the fraud, abuse, and spend-control layer, implementing velocity detection, circuit breakers, and anomaly gates to stop runaway workloads before they impact the bottom line.As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead a team of experienced managers and/or senior engineers (8+) who expect a manager with real technical depth. You'll own architecture and delivery, and partner closely with PMs, Finance, Risk, Support, Phone & WhatsApp channel teams, and payment providers to keep money movement correct, auditable, and fast.

Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

lists.content:
• End-to-End Product Ownership:
  • Translate business goals into working, deployable systems
  • Define architecture, workflows, and implementation plans
  • Ship and maintain production-grade systems — not demos or prototypes

  • Rapid Prototyping & Iteration:
  • Turn ambiguous ideas into working demos within hours or days
  • Prototype using code, AI tooling, automation, or low-code systems
  • Validate through experiments and real user feedback, then iterate to production quality

  • Build AI-Native Systems: 
  • Design and orchestrate LLM agents, retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, memory layers, APIs, and guardrails. Build for resilience against hallucinations, model variability, and quality degradation over time.

  • Design for Scale, Cost & Performance:

  • Build evaluation loops for continuous quality improvement
  • Automate workflows that increase engineering velocity
  • Maintain clear, repeatable documentation

  • High ownership mindset; operates well with minimal supervision

• Experience building LLM-based or AI-driven products

descriptionPlain:
About Us
HighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users  with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.
 
Our People
With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.
 
Our Impact
As of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.
 
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
 
Who You Are:
As an Advisor your sole responsibility is positioning yourself as the subject matter expert on software business growth through the effective use of technology. The Advisor utilizes their expertise in business process/change management and software technologies by implementing software best practices and ensuring adoption and success with HighLevel software. Including detailed onboarding playbooks and building relationships with customers, business needs, and company.

  • Working with other departments and personnel to ensure information on customer needs are communicated.

  • Responsible for driving consulting milestones and achieving the agreed-upon implementation
  • schedule.

  • successful Implementation.

  • Drive collaboration between internal functional teams and customers to achieve milestones and deliverables.

  • Develop a strong rapport with new accounts to ensure they are enthusiastic about HighLevel and set up for long-term success.

  • Maintain product knowledge and consistent education.
  • Cross-training with other success functions.
  • Other duties may be assigned and/or modified as business needs change

• Associate degree or equivalent work experience and a minimum of two years of Customer success/software implementation/consulting experience or technical support.

  • Strong skills, tact and diplomacy in dealing with sensitive customer issues, with exceptional follow-through ability and communication skills.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of internal systems preferred (HighLevel, Freshdesk, etc.).
  • Strong understanding and proficiency in software solutions and professional service offerings.
  • 2+ years of customer consulting work experience preferred.
  • 2+ years of marketing experience is a plus!
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • IT technical skills and platform integrations.
  • Experience in managing a diverse group and training each according to company standards.
  • Great communication skills, verbal, written, and presentation capabilities with both customers and leadership.
  • Self-starter, with a strong sense of ownership, assertive follow-through, and a passion for the highest level of customer satisfaction.

  • Ability to produce high-quality documents, SOP’s and customer journey Playbooks.
  • Strong computer literacy, including MS Office Suite, Internet applications, and comfort and ability

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.
 
Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
 
Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts 
 
Who You Are:
 
As an Advisor your sole responsibility is positioning yourself as the subject matter expert on software business growth through the effective use of technology. The Advisor utilizes their expertise in business process/change management and software technologies by implementing software best practices and ensuring adoption and success with HighLevel software. Including detailed onboarding playbooks and building relationships with customers, business needs, and company.

Who You Are: 
You are a highly skilled video content creator who combines creative storytelling, technical production expertise, and AI-powered content workflows to produce engaging content at scale.
You understand that modern content production is no longer limited by manual editing. You actively leverage AI tools to accelerate ideation, scripting, editing, transcription, localization, content repurposing, metadata generation, asset organization, performance analysis, and workflow automation. You know when to use AI to improve speed and efficiency and when human judgment, creativity, and brand stewardship are required.
You are not only an AI user—you are an AI workflow builder. You understand how to design, configure, test, and optimize AI agents that support content production workflows. You can identify repetitive production tasks, translate them into automated workflows, and leverage AI agents to improve content velocity, consistency, discoverability, and operational efficiency across the content lifecycle.
You are equally comfortable behind a camera, in an editing suite, supporting live productions, or building scalable content systems that enable teams to create more content with greater consistency and impact.
You thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment and enjoy transforming customer stories, product education, events, webinars, podcasts, and thought leadership content into high-performing assets across multiple channels and formats.
You are passionate about content that helps customers learn, adopt, and succeed with HighLevel while continuously exploring new AI-driven production techniques that increase output, quality, and business impact.
What You’ll Be Doing: 
AI-Powered Content Creation & Production
Create high-quality video content for customer marketing, product education, events, webinars, podcasts, social media, and internal initiatives.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate content ideation, scripting, storyboarding, shot planning, creative concept generation, and production workflows.
Produce product tutorials, feature walkthroughs, customer success stories, promotional content, educational videos, and event recap content.
Use AI-assisted editing workflows to improve production speed while maintaining creative quality and brand standards.
Transform complex product concepts into engaging, easy-to-understand visual content.
Produce screen recordings, demos, product explainers, and instructional videos that drive customer adoption and engagement.
Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Events teams to identify content opportunities and develop impactful assets.
Continuously evaluate emerging AI video technologies and implement best practices that improve efficiency, scalability, and content performance.
AI-Enhanced Video Editing & Post Production
Edit long-form and short-form content using industry-standard editing platforms and AI-powered creative tools.
Utilize AI for transcription, caption generation, subtitle creation, audio cleanup, noise reduction, translation, localization, content summarization, and editing acceleration.
Create polished visual experiences through motion graphics, transitions, animations, visual effects, and branded storytelling elements.
Develop AI-assisted workflows that reduce production turnaround times while maintaining quality standards.
Optimize content formats for YouTube, social media, paid campaigns, product education, community engagement, and internal communications.
Ensure all content aligns with HighLevel brand standards, messaging, and creative guidelines.
Content Repurposing, Clip Farming & Distribution
Analyze long-form content and identify high-value moments for repurposing into short-form content.
Use AI-powered clipping and content intelligence tools to extract key insights, highlights, customer stories, educational moments, and promotional opportunities.
Create platform-specific content variations optimized for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, LinkedIn, paid social, email campaigns, and community channels.
Generate AI-assisted content summaries, descriptions, titles, thumbnails, metadata, and supporting promotional assets.
Maximize content ROI by extending the lifecycle and reach of existing content assets.
Onsite Production & Studio Operations
Support onsite production for customer interviews, executive content, webinars, podcasts, product launches, events, and in-office productions.
Assist with camera operation, lighting, audio capture, livestream support, AV setup, and production troubleshooting.
Help manage production environments to ensure professional-quality recordings.
Partner with stakeholders to plan and execute content capture sessions efficiently and effectively.
Serve as a trusted production partner during live and recorded events.
AI-Driven Content Operations & Asset Management
Maintain and organize a scalable digital asset management system for raw footage, edited content, creative assets, and production files.
Leverage AI tools to automate tagging, categorization, metadata generation, searchability, and content retrieval.
Build repeatable workflows that improve content discoverability and enable teams to easily access and reuse content assets.
Create systems that support large-scale content production and future content needs.
Continuously identify automation opportunities that improve team productivity and operational efficiency.
Content Analytics & Optimization
Monitor content performance across platforms and channels.
Utilize AI-powered analytics and content intelligence platforms to identify trends, engagement patterns, audience behaviors, and optimization opportunities.
Provide recommendations that improve watch time, retention, conversion, engagement, and content effectiveness.
Partner with Marketing teams to continuously improve creative performance through testing and iteration.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Support, Events, Community, and Executive teams.
Translate stakeholder goals into effective video content strategies and deliverables.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality, organization, and timely execution.
Contribute ideas that improve creative output, production processes, AI adoption, and content scalability across the organization.
What You’ll Bring:
To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of creative excellence, production expertise, operational discipline, and strong AI fluency.
You understand how to blend human creativity with AI-enabled workflows to create more content, faster, while maintaining exceptional quality and audience engagement.
Experience/Education/Certifications Required:
3–6 years of experience in video production, content creation, multimedia production, digital marketing content, or a related field.
Proven experience creating high-quality content for marketing, customer education, product adoption, social media, paid media, podcasts, webinars, or events.
Advanced proficiency with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Descript, Canva, or equivalent platforms.
Demonstrated experience using AI-powered content creation, editing, transcription, localization, or workflow automation tools.
Strong understanding of AI-assisted video production workflows and emerging generative AI technologies.
Experience producing screen recordings, product demos, tutorials, educational content, and customer-facing video assets.
Experience supporting onsite production environments including cameras, lighting, audio, livestreaming, and AV systems.
Strong storytelling, visual communication, pacing, editing, and audience engagement skills.
Ability to independently manage projects from concept through final delivery.
Strong organizational skills with experience managing large content libraries and creative assets.
Experience identifying and repurposing high-performing content from long-form recordings.
Ability to balance speed, creativity, quality, and business priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
High attention to detail and commitment to producing polished, professional content.
Portfolio demonstrating video production, editing, storytelling, and content creation capabilities.

About Highlevel
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.
Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
Our impact 
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our  YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
About the Role
We’re looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join our AI Studio Team, the group responsible for building AI Studio — an AI-based React application builder that generates production-ready websites and other React applications from natural language, which users can then connect to custom domains and publish live to the internet — from prompt-driven app generation, component and layout creation, automated copy/design generation, real-time preview and editing, to one-click deployment across our product ecosystem.
This team owns the intelligence layer that helps millions of SMBs build production-ready websites and React applications without technical expertise. The AI Studio platform orchestrates complex workflows across data processing, LLM-powered reasoning, code and component generation, design generation, and live deployment to custom domains. With millions of applications and billions of visitor interactions flowing through our systems, reliability, correctness, and performance are mission-critical.

lists.content:
As a Lead Engineer, you will drive the technical direction for our AI-driven application-builder architecture, lead complex system design decisions, and serve as a hands-on technical leader and mentor for the engineers building AI Studio’s app generation engine, React website/app builder, design and component systems, domain publishing pipeline, and AI Agents. This is a hands-on individual contributor role — you’ll spend the majority of your time designing systems and writing production code — while partnering closely with product, infra, and design to shape the roadmap, raise engineering standards, and deliver intuitive, generative, high-performance user experiences at scale.

Architecture & Platform Ownership

  • Own architecture and scaling decisions for core AI Studio platform components (e.g., App Generation Engine, React Build & Render Pipeline, Domain & Publishing Pipeline, AI Content Systems)

  • Lead design and implementation of cross-cutting initiatives to improve system responsiveness, generation accuracy, and platform robustness

  • Build scalable, fault-tolerant LLM pipelines for content generation, layout creation, experimentation, and AI-driven user guidance

    • AI & Distributed Systems Engineering

  • Work hands-on with technologies like Go, NestJS, Node, PostgreSQL, Firestore, Vector Databases, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare KV, and microservices

  • Design distributed systems that handle high-throughput generative and analytical workloads while ensuring correctness and low latency

  • Build and optimize embeddings pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent orchestration frameworks

    • Quality, Observability & Reliability

  • Drive improvements in observability using Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and structured logging

  • Establish and maintain SLOs for generation latency, correctness, model safety, and system uptime

  • Strengthen resiliency and failover strategies to ensure seamless user experiences during traffic spikes and model load variations

    • AI Guardrails, Safety & Tooling

  • Implement hallucination mitigation strategies (code constraints, structured outputs, model verification layers, retrieval guards, test scaffolding)

  • Collaborate with infra and security to enforce data governance, access control, privacy boundaries, and compliance around user-generated data

  • Leverage LLMs and AI tools to write, test, and debug code — while driving standards that ensure reliability and consistency across engineering teams

    • Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing, leading by influence to promote technical excellence, code quality, and a high-ownership culture (this is an individual contributor role with no direct reports)

  • Partner with PMs, designers, and other engineering leaders to define long-term roadmap and deliver high-performing AI-powered application-building features

  • Participate in reviews, deep dives, and on-call rotations to maintain a culture of accountability and operational excellence

Core Experience

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience, including distributed system design and high-scale platform development

  • Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) for building high-performance, concurrent backend services, alongside Node/NestJS experience

  • Hands-on experience building and operating edge/serverless services with Cloudflare Workers and Cloudflare KV (or comparable edge compute and distributed key-value stores)

  • Deep expertise in event-driven architectures, asynchronous workflows, and high-throughput data pipelines.

  • Strong command of relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL data models, query optimization, and complex transactional data

  • Fluency in LLM integrations, vector search, embeddings, RAG patterns, and generative AI frameworks

  • Familiarity with frontend architecture using Vue, and a solid understanding of UI/UX principles

    • Operational Excellence

  • Experience with monitoring, alerting, and incident response for production systems

  • Strong instincts for scaling, latency optimization, and reliability under real-world load

    • AI & LLM Safety

  • Experience implementing structured generation, verification layers, retrieval-based grounding, and guardrails to reduce hallucinations

  • Understanding of prompt engineering patterns, context injection, and model evaluation

    • Soft Skills

  • Exceptional communication and cross-functional leadership capabilities

  • Pragmatic decision-making with a balance of long-term vision and iterative execution

descriptionPlain:
About Us
HighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 1 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users  with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 15 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million domain names.
 
Our People
With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.
 
Our Impact
As of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.
 
About the Role
We’re looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join our Funnel & Website Builder team, the group behind one of HighLevel’s most heavily used and business-critical product surfaces. The Builder ecosystem powers the end-to-end experience for creating funnels and websites: real-time collaborative editing, rendering, publishing, analytics, AI-assisted creation, and global delivery at scale.As a Lead Engineer, you will balance technical leadership with team leadership, spending roughly 50% of your time managing and guiding engineers, driving execution, and ensuring alignment and the remaining 50% contributing hands-on to building impactful features, improving architecture, and elevating code quality. You will steward delivery across multiple squads in the Builder ecosystem, partnering closely with product, design, infra, and security teams. You’ll ensure smooth sprint execution, maintain engineering excellence, remove blockers, guide architects and developers, and ensure the direction of the product is technically sound, scalable, and stable. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for both people outcomes and product outcomes.

About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
 
 
Role Summary:
We’re hiring a Lead Engineer, Workflow Builder DSL to define and enforce the data-layer grammar that powers every automation inside HighLevel.
Your mission: ensure workflows are valid by construction and programmatically safe to create, through strict contracts, semantic validation, static analysis, and high-coverage tests.
You’ll own the canonical Workflow DSL that represents how workflows are structured, stored, and validated. Your work guarantees that every workflow, whether created in the UI, cloned via snapshot, or generated programmatically, is predictable, version-safe, and never corrupt.

lists.content:
• Define the DSL: Design and maintain the canonical syntax and semantics for workflows
  • Schema authority: Own JSON Schemas and TypeScript types for validation, linting, and generation
  • Programmatic CRUD: Design contracts for safe workflow creation via public and internal APIs
  • Validation layer: Implement semantic validators (current POC in Zod; open to alternatives)
  • Linting & codemods: Ship tools that enforce structure guardrails and auto-repair common errors
  • Testing discipline: Establish unit, integration, and golden tests for workflow creation paths
  • Static analysis: Add graph checks for loops, dangling nodes, and invalid edges
  • Cross-team contracts: Define interfaces with Engine and Snapshot for schema exchange and validation
  • Operational ownership: Monitor DSL validation services; ensure 99.9 % availability and low error rate

• 7+ years building and owning complex backend systems.
  • Deep experience with typed DSLs, ASTs, or schema-driven architectures
  • Fluent in TypeScript and validation frameworks (Zod, Ajv, or JSON Schema)
  • Proven history designing public or versioned APIs
  • Strong testing discipline and data-integrity mindset
  • Comfortable owning production services and reliability metrics
  • Nice to have: compiler/graph background, schema evolution work, or tooling for developer productivity

About the Role
We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.
As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.
We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.
Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
What You Can Expect
Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.
Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.
The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.
Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.
A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.
A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.
What We Are Looking For
7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.
An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.
Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.
Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.
Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.
Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.
Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.
Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.
In This Role, You Will
Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.
Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.
Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.
Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.
Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.
Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.
Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.
Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.
How You Work
You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.
You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.
You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.
You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.
You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.
You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.
You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional design craft and consistently raise the quality bar across the teams they work with. Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.
What You Can Expect
Autonomy to shape HighLevel's most important product experiences by defining how customers create and publish digital experiences.
Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.
The opportunity to raise the design bar across visual editing, templates, canvas interactions, publishing flows and AI-assisted creation.
Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.
A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.
Work in a 100% remote environment where thoughtful collaboration across US and India time zones is part of everyday work.

7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in creator tools, WYSIWYG editors, drag-and-drop editors, no-code builders, SaaS, B2B, platform or workflow-heavy product environments is highly valuable.
An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.
Proven experience leading product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.
Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.
Experience designing visual creation workflows such as drag-and-drop editing, page or email composition, responsive layout controls, asset management, templates, previews, publishing flows or versioning.
Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including AI-assisted creation, recommendations, automation or guided editing workflows.
Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.
Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, customer-facing teams, stakeholders and other designers.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.
In This Role, You Will
Lead design strategy and execution for Builder pod experiences from discovery through delivery.
Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction for creator workflows.
Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.
Design and refine complex editing experiences, including canvases, controls, templates, responsive behaviors, previews, publishing states and AI-assisted workflows.
Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.
Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.
Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.
Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move clearly.
How You Work
You raise the quality bar across every project you contribute to.
You excel at framing the right problems before exploring solutions, designing experiences that feel intuitive for first-time users while remaining efficient and powerful for experienced users.
You build strong partnerships with Product, Engineering, Data, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams to align on problems, make informed decisions, and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
You care about the difference between a tool that merely works and a tool that makes creators feel capable, fast and in control.
You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.
You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates.
You enjoy collaborating across time zones and diverse cultural contexts.
You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical product design.

About Us
HighLevel is an AI powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 1 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users  with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.
 
Our People
With over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.
 
Our Impact
As of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.
 
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

• Demonstrated expertise in cloud security architecture across AWS/GCP/Azure, including designing secure, scalable cloud environments with a strong focus on identity, network security, encryption, and compliance best practices.
  • Extensive experience conducting security architecture reviews for distributed systems and cloud-native applications, identifying design risks early and recommending secure, scalable architectural patterns aligned with business and engineering goals.
  • Perform and lead manual and automated penetration testing across applications, APIs, and cloud services
  • Drive threat modeling and secure architecture reviews across app and infrastructure layers
  • Collaborate with Infra/DevOps on cloud network architecture, including VPC design, security groups, routing, and segmentation
  • Design and advise on cloud-native security controls — IAM hardening, role boundaries, secrets management, least privilege
  • Evaluate and improve Kubernetes and container security posture (runtime, image, and network layers)Implement secure-by-default patterns across SDLC, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-CodeMonitor emerging threats, CVEs, and vulnerabilities relevant to our stack (web, cloud, infra)
  • Influence internal security tooling, automation pipelines, and security review processes
  • Serve as a security advisor to engineering, SRE, and product teams across key projects

• 8+ years of experience in Application Security, Product Security, or Cloud Security, with a strong focus on securing large-scale cloud-native applications.
  • Strong hands-on experience with threat modeling, secure architecture reviews, and pen testing
  • Familiar with OWASP Top 10, STRIDE, and modern security frameworks
  • Experience with tools like Burp Suite, ZAP, Snyk, Metasploit, Semgrep
  • Ability to read and analyze code (e.g., JavaScript, Go, PHP, or Node.js)Working knowledge of cloud security principles (preferably AWS)

• Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms or white-labeled architectures
  • Familiarity with network-level security concepts: VPC design, IAM, zero-trust networksExposure to container security (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Background in B2B SaaS, especially servicing regulated industries (health, legal, finance)
  • Hands-on with IaC security and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Terraform)
