We're looking for a Senior Manager of Analytics Engineering to lead the team responsible for building the trusted data foundation, i.e. semantic metrics layer, that powers decision-making across the company. You'll oversee a team of analytics engineers who transform raw data into scalable, reliable, and well-governed data models that enable self-service analytics, operational reporting, experimentation, and AI-driven products. 

As a cross-functional leader, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership to define our data strategy and ensure high-quality, accessible data at scale. You'll balance technical excellence with business impact, helping the organization become increasingly data-driven while building a high-performing and inclusive team.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team of Analytics Engineers

  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, continuous learning, and collaboration

  • Provide coaching, career development, and regular performance feedback

  • Establish team goals, operating rhythms, and execution processes that align with company priorities to deliver business impact

    • Analytics Engineering Strategy

    • Define and execute the roadmap for analytics engineering, data modeling, semantic layers, and analytics infrastructure

    • Build scalable dimensional models and curated datasets that enable trusted reporting and advanced analytics

    • Drive adoption of analytics engineering best practices including testing, documentation, version control, CI/CD, and code review

    • Own data quality initiatives, observability, lineage, and governance across the analytics ecosystem

    • Continuously improve developer productivity and platform scalability

      • Cross-Functional Partnership

      • Partner with peers on the Data team and business stakeholders to understand evolving analytical needs and translate them into scalable data products

      • Collaborate with Data Engineering to improve data pipelines, ingestion, orchestration, and warehouse performance

      • Work alongside Product Analytics & Data Science to enable experimentation, machine learning, and advanced analytics

      • Support Finance and Executive Leadership with trusted metrics and executive reporting

      • Help establish company-wide metric definitions and ensure consistency across teams

        • Technical Leadership

        • Set standards for data modeling, transformation, documentation, and testing

        • Guide architectural decisions for the analytics stack and evaluate new technologies

        • Ensure analytics infrastructure scales with rapid business growth

        • Review technical designs and mentor engineers through complex implementation challenges

        • Champion automation, reliability, and engineering best practices throughout the data organization

        • Thinks strategically while remaining execution-oriented, making pragmatic trade offs between speed, scalability, and technical debt

        • Builds trust through transparency and strong communication, delegating to and developing future technical leaders

        • Thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and helps others navigate change

• 11+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, or related fields
  • 3+ years managing high-performing technical teams, growing and developing people
  • Deep expertise with SQL and modern analytics engineering practices
  • Experience building analytics platforms using DBT, Snowflake, Airflow or similar orchestration tools
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows and BI platforms
  • Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, semantic layers, and data warehousing concepts
  • Experience defining data governance, testing, and data quality frameworks
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical strategy across multiple organizations

• Experience partnering with accounting/close the books procedures at a public company
  • Experience managing audit processes and governance programs is a plus
  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS or technology company
  • Experience scaling analytics organizations through rapid company growth
  • Familiarity with event-driven data architectures and product analytics
  • Experience supporting experimentation platforms and machine learning initiatives
  • Knowledge of metrics governance and executive KPI frameworks

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
About the Team
The Workflows Module is the key component of HighLevel’s automation engine, enabling agencies and businesses to create powerful, automated workflows that enhance efficiency, save time, and improve outcomes. By integrating with multiple product areas within the HighLevel platform, the Workflows Module empowers users to streamline processes, nurture leads, and manage tasks seamlessly.
As part of the team, you’ll work on improving existing capabilities within workflows, conceptualizing new workflow features, and delivering solutions that drive adoption, activation, and business growth. The team is committed to optimizing user experience, increasing efficiency, and helping customers get the most value out of HighLevel.
 
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Workflows Team. This role is perfect for a self-driven individual who is passionate about automation and SaaS products. As a SPM, you will help build impactful features and refine existing capabilities in the Workflows Module, making it easier for users to automate complex business processes.
You will work closely with Product Managers and cross-functional teams to understand user pain points, develop innovative solutions, and ensure seamless execution. You will play a critical role in driving product success by leveraging data, user insights, and collaborative teamwork.
Your Responsibilities
You will own key parts of the Workflows product experience across activation, builder usability, execution reliability, and long-term engagement. This includes identifying high-impact opportunities across the workflow funnel, simplifying complex automation journeys, and partnering with cross-functional teams to ship scalable improvements that help customers automate more of their business operations.
 
Workflow Funnel Optimization: Identify and close gaps from workflow creation to execution to improve activation and adoption rates across accounts.
Time to Value Acceleration: Drive initiatives that make it faster and easier for users to launch their first meaningful automation.
Retention & Engagement: Lead efforts to make workflows a sticky, high-usage product that users return to regularly.
Builder Simplicity & Usability: Champion ease-of-use by simplifying complex concepts, refining the UI, and reducing friction in critical paths.
Template & Entry Point Expansion:Launch iterative improvements to templates, hotlinks and suggested workflows to bridge intent and execution.
Support Insight to Product Fixes: Analyze support tickets and user feedback to identify and resolve common sources of confusion or setup failure.
Optimizing existing workflows, ensuring they are intuitive, scalable and aligned with customer needs.
Manage New Features: Managing workflow feature requests, tracking, prioritizing and ensuring timely execution of essential updates.
Cross Team Collaboration: Collaborating with other product teams (CRM, Reporting, Payments, AI, and Integrations) to ensure seamless cross-functional workflow improvements.
Tracking Metrics: Tracking performance metrics to identify usability bottlenecks, activation & adoption trends, and areas for optimization.
Staying updated on industry trends in automation, integrations, and no-code/low-code platforms to drive innovation within workflows.

Your Core Skills
 
Passionate about building intuitive and scalable workflow automation solutions.
Ability to deeply understand user problems, spot friction in product flows, and make thoughtful trade-offs between power and simplicity.
Comfort with digging into usage data, funnels, and support patterns to find actionable insights.
Understanding of product development lifecycle and experience working on SaaS products.
Strong analytical mindset to interpret user behavior, identify pain points, and optimize workflow functionalities.
Leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and drive initiatives forward.
Understanding of automation tools and workflow best practices to enhance user experience.
Ability to deconstruct complex software experiences and highlight good UX from bad UX.
Familiarity with workflow automation platforms is a plus.
A problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment.
Experience
8+ years of Product Management experience ideally in SaaS or automation platforms
Proven track record of shipping complex, user-facing features in a fast-paced environment
Proven experience owning large-scale, customer-facing product platforms
Experience working on workflow automation tools or CRM platforms is a plus

Deep Understanding of:
 
Workflow builders, automations and no-code or low-code platforms
Product funnels: activation, retention, and reducing time to value
Identifying friction points in UX and translating feedback/support data into product decisions
Cross-team platform work: enabling other product teams through triggers, actions, and integrations
Working with engineering on large-scale frontend + backend architecture (especially builder-like UIs)
Running feature discovery and validation loops with beta users
Partnering closely with design to simplify complex systems and reduce cognitive load
Writing clear, structured PRDs and communicating roadmap tradeoffs to stakeholders
Analyzing data from tools like Superset, Pendo or Tableau to inform product decisions
 
Why Should You Join Us?
 
At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company. 
 
Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

We run a Go domain tier behind ConnectRPC and protobuf, deployed on GKE with Istio mTLS in STRICT mode. Financial truth lives in TigerBeetle, with PostgreSQL carrying metadata. We run a Go domain tier behind ConnectRPC and protobuf, deployed on GKE with Istio mTLS in STRICT mode. Financial truth lives in TigerBeetle, with PostgreSQL carrying metadata. Authorization runs on a ReBAC substrate (SpiceDB/OpenFGA). Roughly 40 engineers across seven teams, each with a single clear charter.

This is a platform with real money moving through it and real merchants depending on it. The work is correctness-sensitive and the feedback loop is short.

lists.content:
You'll be placed on one team with one charter.
 
Depending on where you land, that could look like: -
  • Domain services in Go — designing protobuf contracts, implementing ConnectRPC handlers, and taking a service from ADR to production behind a flag. - 
  • Ledger and accounting— posting commerce events into a double-entry ledger in real time, building chart-of-accounts translation, and shipping journal APIs that external systems can read. 
  • Payments infrastructure— provider integrations, capability registries, idempotency and replay semantics for operations that must never double-charge. - 
  • Document rendering — a cross-runtime templating engine with a conformance suite that keeps Go, JS, and Dart implementations honest. - 
  • Developer tooling and MCP— protobuf-first code generation, manifest generators, and governance annotations that let AI agents call our APIs safely. 
  • You'll write ADRs, review other people's designs, and carry your own on-call context for what you ship. Interns here merge to `main` in week two.
    • Programme Details:
  • Work Type: Apprenticeship
  • Department: Engineering
  • Sub Department: Mobile & Commerce
  • Duration: 6months
  • Monthly Stipend: 50,000 INR
  • Location: Remote - India
  • Programme Start: September 2026

You'll be a strong fit if you have: -
  •  A completed term in a recognized open source mentorship or contribution program, with merged and reviewed work in a real project — we will read your PRs. 
  •  Working fluency in Go, or demonstrated depth in another systems language plus evidence you pick things up fast.
  • Comfort with distributed systems fundamentals: idempotency, retries, consistency models, and what happens when the network lies to you.
  • Familiarity with containers and Kubernetes at the level of "I have debugged why my pod won't start."
  • The habit of writing things down — design docs, issue threads, commit messages that explain why.
  • Graduation timeline that allows a full-time conversion at the end of the term.
  • Signals we weight heavily - Sustained contribution to a single project across many months. 
  •  Public review threads where you argued a position and changed your mind well.
  • Anything you've built that handles money, correctness invariants, or multi-tenant isolation.
  • Conference talks, blog posts, or upstream spec proposals (SEPs, KEPs, RFCs).
  •  Curiosity about the business problem underneath the ticket.

lists.text: What the six months look like:
lists.content:
• Weeks 1–3: Environment, codebase tour, and a scoped starter charter that touches production. Y
  • Weeks 4–16.: Your primary charter. One substantial piece of the platform that is yours to design, build, instrument, and ship. You'll present the design to the org and defend the tradeoffs.
  • Weeks 17–24: Hardening, migration, and handoff — or extension into a second charter if the first lands early. Conversion conversations begin around week 18.

Team & System Overview:
The Conversations organization powers multi-channel communication across SMS, Email, WhatsApp, and DMs — handling over 2B messages each month. The Threads & Composer team owns the inbox and composer surfaces, and the backend services that deliver and store those interactions.You’ll work across Node.js microservices, GCP-based infra (GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks), and MongoDB/Firestore storage layers, ensuring every message and UI state stays consistent, fast, and recoverable.

lists.content:
• Backend ownership: Design and maintain Node.js/NestJS services for message storage, retrieval, and state sync
  • API design: Build well-typed REST contracts for Threads and Composer operations
  • Data layer work: Model and optimize MongoDB/Firestore schemas for high read/write volumes and atomic updates
  • Scalability & resilience: Implement queues, caching, and rate limiting to handle burst traffic gracefully
  • Frontend integration: Ship modular Vue 3 UIs that consume your APIs efficiently and handle realtime state updates
  • Observability: Instrument logs, metrics, and traces to monitor latency, error rates, and throughput
  • Testing discipline: Maintain high coverage across unit, integration, and contract tests
  • Production ownership: Participate in on-call, debug incidents, and drive post-mortem action items to closure
  • Collaboration & mentorship: Work closely with Product and Frontend leads while reviewing code and supporting junior engineers

• 4+ years of professional engineering experience, preferably backend-heavy full-stack work
  • Expert in Node.js and TypeScript; comfortable with NestJS or Express microservices
  • Proficient in Vue 3 or similar modern frontend frameworks
  • Strong understanding of API design, data modeling, and distributed system patterns
  • Experience with GCP (or AWS), containerization, and CI/CD automation
  • Hands-on with observability and production monitoring
  • Bonus: Pub/Sub or message queue experience; event-driven or domain-driven design background

• Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS / Express, REST APIs
  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, Vite / Webpack, Tailwind
  • Storage: MongoDB, Firestore, Redis
  • Infra: GCP (GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Stackdriver)
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes
  • Testing: Jest, Vitest

About the Team:
The Social Planner team is a dedicated product group within HighLevel’s Leadgen organization, focused on delivering a seamless social media management experience. We empower agencies and businesses to create, schedule, and manage posts across multiple platforms, while also providing automation, analytics, and engagement tools. 
 
Our primary objectives are to drive Social Planner adoption, improve feature retention, and maximize user engagement by making social publishing effortless and impactful.
 
We are responsible for: 
Post Publishing & Scheduling We enable agencies to publish and schedule posts across major social platforms, ensuring timely and consistent content delivery.
Post Automation We support advanced publishing workflows, including CSV uploads, RSS-to-post, Review Posts, Category Queues, and Recurring Queues—giving agencies full flexibility to manage content at scale.
Engagement & Insights Through Social Statistics, Comment Management, and Social Listening, we provide agencies with deep insights into performance and engagement, enabling data-driven content strategies.
Best Time to Post We surface AI-driven recommendations on when to post for maximum reach and engagement, helping agencies optimize their content strategy.
Multi-Platform Integration We currently support integrations with 9 major platforms—Google Business Profile, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, and Bluesky—along with HighLevel’s internal Community product.
 
🌍 Scale & Reach:
1.6M+ social accounts connected to HighLevel through Social Planner
2,000+ new accounts added daily
22.6M posts published this year alone
100K+ posts published daily through our platform
This scale demonstrates Social Planner’s critical role in powering social presence for agencies worldwide.
 
About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer with strong technical and communication skills who has developed full stack web apps, created solid APIs and beautiful interfaces for consuming them in user friendly apps. Focusing on details and well written self documented code are essential for this position. You can expect to collaborate with a solid team of designers, product managers, developers and testers on a daily basis. You must be experienced in building highly scalable and resilient systems that can meet our customer needs.

lists.content:
• Improve and create new lead capture domain models.
  • Build backend & Frontend API features and architecture.
  • Work cross-functionally across our platform, experience, integrations, payments and marketplace teams.
  • Drive performance through benchmarking and optimization
  • Work with a wide range of systems, processes, and technologies to own and solve problems from end to end
  • Collaborate closely with our leadership team including engineers, designers, and product managers to build new features and products
  • Uphold high engineering standards and bring consistency to the many codebases and systems you will encounter.
  • Work on 1 to 2 products.
  • Create and improve lead capture tools like funnels, websites, forms, surveys, social media
  • Architect and build backend & Frontend APIs and features

• 4+ years of experience in a full-stack environment.
  • Develop and maintain a highly scalable email builder web App, enabling customers to send ~30 million emails per day. Manage email statistics and integrate with internal teams leveraging email builder templates.
  • Scale and optimize our countdown timer, used across emails, websites, and funnels, with more than 300K daily views. Design and develop Brand Board, a tool that helps customers build and integrate their brand identity seamlessly across the platform. Optimize application performance and scalability using modern development practices.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and implement improvements to existing systems.
  • Proficient with various programming languages and tools such as but not limited to Javascript, TypeScript, Vue.js, NodeJS, and GraphQL Must be able to work with a team and collaborate remotely.
  • You have an entrepreneurial mindset, are eager to take on different roles when necessary and know how to navigate a start-up environment. You are fulfilled by being a generalist working on both the frontend, backend, and anything it takes to solve problems and delight users and take pride in working on projects involving a variety of technologies and systems.
  • Ability to stitch together many different services and processes together, even if you have not worked with them before.
  • Hold a great deal of empathy for your team and users, you are a steward of crafting great experiences.
  • Have great communication skills and can thrive in a highly collaborative environment when working cross-functionally with many stakeholders.
  • Driven by product quality, and innately know how to balance trade-offs with time to launch new features.
  • A keen eye for design and love to think about user flows and user experiences. Must have experience with HTML5 and CSS3

About the Role
We’re looking for a seasoned Senior FullStack Engineer (SDE III) to join our Users Module team, where you'll design and build scalable, secure user management systems. This includes working on authentication, authorization, and complex permission hierarchies across a multi-tenant SaaS platform.You’ll collaborate cross-functionally to deliver reliable, performant, and secure experiences for millions of users.

lists.content:
• Write clean, maintainable code in TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Build and maintain robust RESTful APIs for user management and authentication
  • Design scalable multi-tenant user data models and schemas
  • Implement OAuth, JWT, and secure session management
  • Design and implement IAM v2 systems with RBAC and granular permissions
  • Build features like user impersonation, delegation, and permission templates
  • Create and manage token validation and session lifecycle flows
  • Architect scalable models using MongoDB, Firestore, and SQL
  • Integrate Elasticsearch for advanced user search and filtering
  • Sync user data across multiple stores and implement audit logging
  • Build secure auth flows with encryption, token validation, and data privacy controls
  • Ensure compliance with GDPR and similar regulations
  • Create audit trails and compliance reporting for user actions
  • Optimize queries, implement caching strategies, and handle high-volume user operations
  • Build systems that scale across enterprise-grade customer environments
  • Partner with product, security, and platform teams to deliver features
  • Collaborate with DevOps on deployment and infrastructure
  • Mentor junior engineers and participate in architecture discussions and code reviews

• 4+ years in backend engineering, preferably building user management systems
  • Proven work on authentication/authorization and IAM systems
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS and enterprise user workflows & permissions

• Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js
  • Frameworks: NestJS, Express.js
  • Databases: MongoDB, Firestore, SQL
  • Authentication: OAuth 2.0, JWT, session management
  • Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Messaging: Google Cloud Pub/SubDevOps: Git, CI/CD
  • Search: Elasticsearch, Clickhouse
  • Architecture: Microservices, Event driven architecture, IAM, RBAC

  • Comfortable with CI/CD processes, containerization, and cloud environments

  • Strong communication and documentation skills.

Technical Mastery

  • Backend: Strong experience in Node Js, with solid understanding of REST API design, microservices architecture, and scalable systems

    • System Design & Architecture

About the Role:
We're seeking Software Development Engineer II with a deep mastery of Futter and a forward-thinking approach to AI-assisted development. If you’ve architected complex systems, shipped high-performance mobile apps at scale, and pushed the boundaries of what AI can do for software engineers — this role is for you. 
You’ll join the team behind our Mobile Platform: a flexible, modular system powering a growing ecosystem of customizable business apps. You’ll be responsible for building features from the ground up, guiding architectural decisions, and pioneering how AI can reliably write code, minimize hallucinations, and enhance every step of our dev lifecycle.

lists.content:
• Architect and own high-performance, scalable mobile software — from initial design to long-term stability and performance.
  • Build production-grade Futter apps used by thousands of customers daily, across diverse industries and use cases.
  • Leverage LLMs and AI tools to write, refactor, test, and debug code effciently — while implementing guardrails to reduce hallucination and boost reliability. 
  • Develop and maintain shared tooling, frameworks, and libraries that empower other engineers to build fast with confdence.
  • Collaborate with designers, PMs, and platform/backend engineers to ship full-stack features. 
  • Measure and improve app performance, test coverage, code health, and build stability using modern dev tooling.
  • Stay on the bleeding edge of AI/LLM technology, Futter best practices, and mobile architecture patterns — and bring that knowledge back to the team.

• 4+ years of professional engineering experience (SDE II/III), including 3+ years in Futter/Dart. 
  • Demonstrated ability to architect maintainable, modular mobile systems. 
  • Mastery of Futter internals, widget lifecycle, performance profling, and popular state management approaches (e.g., Provider, Freezed, Bloc, MobX). 
  • Experience working with Protobuf/gRPC in Dart. 
  • Track record of shipping and supporting large-scale mobile apps in production. 
  • Fluency in RESTful API design, mobile CI/CD, and Git-based workflows. 
  • Strong understanding of AI-driven development tools — including prompt engineering, LLM-based code generation, test writing, and code review automation. 
  • Familiarity with hallucination mitigation strategies (e.g., code constraints, test scaffolding, embeddings, context injection).
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills — especially in distributed, asynchronous teams. 
  • Bonus: Contributions to AI tooling, Futter open-source libraries, or AI-enhanced mobile features.

lists.content:
• Own and evolve the test automation platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and ease of use
  • Design and maintain robust automation frameworks across UI, API, and backend layers
  • Build and enhance internal QA tools that improve test efficiency
  • Drive adoption of automation best practices, coding standards, and efficient test design
  • Implement and maintain test observability systems for reporting, analytics, and defect insights
  • Conduct performance, load, and scalability testing for key features and services
  • Develop and maintain test infrastructure, supporting containerized and distributed environments
  • Collaborate closely with developers, QA, and DevOps to embed quality throughout the delivery pipeline
  • Improve test reliability and flakiness detection through intelligent retry and failure analysis systems
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of tooling, test data management, and CI/CD quality gates
  • Research and implement emerging technologies (AI/ML, LLMs, smart test generation, etc.) to advance test automation capabilities

  • Infrastructure Knowledge: Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Cloud Proficiency: Working knowledge of GCP or AWS for test infrastructure and environment setup
  • API & Backend Testing: Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, request validation, and integration testing
  • Performance Testing: Experience with tools like k6, Locust, or JMeter for load and scalability validation
  • Observability & Reporting: Familiarity with test reporting dashboards, metrics tracking, and alerting (Grafana, Prometheus, Slack integrations)
  • Debugging Skills: Strong ability to diagnose failures in distributed systems and identify root causes quickly
  • Architecture Awareness: Solid understanding of system design, micro-services, databases, and data flow across layers
  • AI/ML Awareness (Preferred): Exposure to AI-assisted testing or LLM-based test generation is a plus
  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills with a cross-functional mindset
  • Mindset: Ownership-driven, curious about platform scalability, and passionate about building tools that enable others to test better

lists.content:
• Lead advanced mobile testing (Android/iOS apps) and automation using BDD frameworks with tools like Flutter Integration test, Appium, Espresso, Maestro etc.
  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, reusable test automation frameworks and solutions using modern technologies
  • Perform advanced multi-platform functional tests and device compatibility testing across diverse environments
  • Debug complex issues at the code, app, and infrastructure levels; identify root causes and provide solutions
  • Sound knowledge using AI tools (ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, custom LLM workflows)
  • Mentor and guide junior SDETs, promoting technical growth within the team
  • Review requirements and actively provide feedback on business and technical completeness and testability
  • Define and implement comprehensive test strategies, methodologies, and best practices to ensure product quality
  • Partner closely with product owners, developers, and DevOps engineers to achieve continuous integration, delivery, and deployment
  • Monitor, analyse, and report test automation metrics to identify areas for improvement
  • Drive continuous improvement in the QA process, automation coverage, and test reliability
  • Take ownership of release quality by supporting regression testing (automated and manual) and providing clear sign-offs

• 4+ years of experience in mobile testing and mobile automation (Flutter Integration test, Appium, Espresso, Maestro etc.)
  • Strong programming skills in Dart, Java, Kotlin, or equivalent languages
  • Proven ability to architect, design, and maintain robust, scalable test automation frameworks
  • Expertise in mobile automation frameworks, including Flutter Driver-based frameworks
  • Expertise in writing and automating test cases for complex features as part of continuous delivery
  • Hands-on experience debugging automation frameworks and app issues
  • Ability to design comprehensive test strategies, ensuring functional and non-functional requirements are met
  • Strong understanding of the full product lifecycle, release metrics, and QA best practices
  • Proficiency in CI/CD tools such as Codemagic, Jenkins, and Bitrise
  • Experience in API testing and automation (Postman, REST-Assured, or similar tools)
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive solutions independently
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working in cross-functional, agile teams

• Knowledge of advanced testing paradigms like declarative testing approaches
  • Experience with performance testing for mobile apps
  • Familiarity with cloud-based device testing platforms like BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or Firebase Test Lab
  • A passion for mentoring and elevating team capabilities

Role Overview
The Sr. Director of Growth will lead the cross-functional growth organization within the Product team, focusing on optimising user acquisition, activation, retention, and monetisation. This leader will own the strategy and execution of growth initiatives that directly impact key company metrics such as trial-to-paid conversion, customer engagement, and churn reduction. You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product Marketing teams to identify high-leverage opportunities across the customer lifecycle, design scalable reward systems, and implement product experiences that drive sustained growth and user delight.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership: Define and execute a holistic product growth strategy aligned with company objectives, focusing on user activation, retention, and expansion

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Marketing, Customer Support, Product Marketing, Engineering, and Data Science to identify growth opportunities and deliver high-impact initiatives

Growth Mechanics Expertise: Design and deploy growth loops, reward systems, and game mechanics that create engagement, habit formation, and referral behaviors within the product ecosystem

Data-Driven Optimization: Identify and track the key upstream actions that influence core downstream business outcomes such as trial-to-paid conversion, customer lifetime value, and churn

Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of Product Managers and Growth Analysts, fostering a culture of experimentation, collaboration, and impact

Experimentation & Testing: Build a culture of rigorous A/B testing and rapid iteration across onboarding flows, pricing experiments, and product engagement funnels

SaaS B2B2C Growth: Leverage deep experience in SaaS B2B2C models to drive scalable product adoption across both business and end-user layers

Insights & Reporting: Collaborate with analytics and finance teams to translate growth performance data into actionable insights and executive-level reporting
Qualifications
 
10+ years of experience in Product Management, Growth, or Product-Led Growth roles within high-growth SaaS environments
5+ years in a senior leadership role managing Product Managers or cross-functional growth teams
Proven track record designing and optimizing growth loops, reward systems, and game mechanics that improve engagement and retention
Deep experience with SaaS B2B2C business models and the unique challenges of scaling multi-tenant customer networks
Expert at identifying high-value upstream actions that predict and influence downstream metrics such as activation, conversion, and churn
Strong analytical and experimental mindset - comfortable with hypothesis-driven testing, cohort analysis, and data-informed decision-making
Excellent communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical teams
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred

Who You Are
You are a seasoned People leader who combines strategic thinking with strong operational execution. You have deep experience partnering with senior GTM leaders in high-growth, fast-moving environments and are comfortable navigating both organizational strategy and day-to-day people challenges.
You are equally comfortable in executive discussions on org design and talent strategy, as you are stepping into complex employee relations situations, performance concerns, organizational change, and operational execution. You thrive in ambiguity, move with urgency, and are known for being pragmatic, hands-on, and solutions-oriented.
You understand that scaling organizations requires both strong people judgment and a willingness to roll up your sleeves to drive outcomes.
About the Role:
As the Sr Director, People Business Partner at HighLevel, you will serve as a senior strategic partner to leaders across our GTM organization. This role is critical in helping scale the business, strengthen leadership effectiveness, and build high-performing teams while ensuring operational discipline and strong employee experience foundations. 
The ideal candidate will bring strong business partnership capability along with the ability to operate effectively in complex, fast-paced environments where execution, judgment, and responsiveness matter equally.
You will work closely with senior leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, performance management, employee relations, change management, leadership coaching, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.
What You’ll Do:
Strategic Business Partnership Partner directly with the People team and their respective leadership teams to design and implement value-led talent strategies that help achieve business goals.Align HR initiatives with business priorities, ensuring a high-performance and inclusive culture.
Organizational Development & Change Management 
Lead workforce planning, talent strategy, and change initiatives to support HighLevel’s rapid scaling.
Implement solutions for organizational transformation, ensuring agility and adaptability.
Champion AI-enabled ways of working across the organization, helping leaders rethink team design, workflows, productivity, and role effectiveness in a rapidly evolving environment.
People & Culture Advocacy 
Act as a champion for company culture, employee engagement, and leadership effectiveness.
Develop and drive initiatives that improve retention, performance, and career growth.
Coaching & Talent Development 
Mentor leaders and managers, providing strategic guidance on performance management, succession planning, and team effectiveness.
Design talent programs that accelerate employee growth and leadership development.
Data-Driven HR & Compliance 
Leverage people analytics to identify trends and drive informed decision-making.
Ensure compliance with labor laws and HR best practices across all operational regions.
Employee Relations & Organizational Risk Management 
Lead and manage complex employee relations matters with sound judgment, balancing business needs, employee experience, and organizational risk.
Partner with Legal and leadership teams on sensitive investigations, performance concerns, escalations, policy interpretation, and organizational actions.
Build leadership capability in handling feedback, accountability, performance rigor, and difficult conversations effectively.
What You’ll Bring:
15+ years of progressive HRBP or HR generalist experience, including significant experience partnering with senior GTM leaders in high-growth technology organizations, with exposure to globally distributed teams and hands-on experience supporting organizations across both India and the United States.
A thought leader with deep, strategic expertise across various HR disciplines, including workforce planning, organisation design, career management, leadership coaching, performance management and employee engagement
Demonstrated experience managing complex employee relations matters, organizational change, and leadership escalations with sound judgment and maturity.
Strong business acumen and the ability to develop and implement strategic HR initiatives that drive business success.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to make informed decisions that align with business goals.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced remote first global environment, managing multiple stakeholders and projects concurrently.
Demonstrated success in partnering with senior leadership to drive strategic initiatives. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build trust with senior leaders. 
Demonstrated ability to help leaders navigate evolving ways of working, including the adoption of AI-enabled tools and more efficient operating models.
Experience in coaching and mentoring leadership at all levels of the organization

Why This Role Exists
The Sr. Director, Product Management (Platform & Core Products) will lead the foundational layer of HighLevel's product stack, spanning infrastructure platforms, automation capabilities, CRM primitives, and shared systems like identity, permissions, notifications, and audit logging.
 
This is a critical org-wide leadership role, owning HighLevel’s platform extensibility, data model reliability, cross-surface consistency, and internal product development velocity. You will manage a team of 25–30 PMs via 3 Group Product Managers and drive strategy, execution, and org design for a portfolio that underpins everything from marketing automation and conversation management to AI-driven workflows and CRM object modeling. 
 
You’ll be expected to scale a high-performance product org, influence product direction across pods, and partner closely with engineering to deliver a scalable, secure, and elegant platform for millions of users. 
 
Strategic Priorities
- Build an Extensible Platform: Architect reusable primitives (identity, roles, objects, notifications, reporting) that enable faster development across HighLevel.
 - Modernize Core CRM: Scale performance and usability across contacts, companies, tasks, opportunities, and conversations — the backbone of daily SMB workflows. 
- Unlock Scalable Automation: Advance our workflows engine and Workflow AI to power increasingly complex use cases with speed and simplicity. 
- Drive UX Consistency Across Surfaces: Ensure UI, interaction patterns, and product language are coherent across contact, sub-account, and agency layers.
- Support Data-Driven Product Maturity: Enforce strong instrumentation, analytics readiness, and reporting across all core products. 
- Operationalize Product Management Excellence: Raise the bar for product planning, prioritization, execution, and accountability across 30+ PMs and APMs.
 
Key Responsibilities
- Define and drive the long term product vision, roadmap, and success metrics for platform and core product areas.
- Manage and coach a team ofGroup PMs and PMs,.cultivating a strong leadership bench and ensuring high performance. 
- Serve as the bridge between platform engineering, infra, and product — enabling other teams to move faster through well-designed interfaces and reusable systems. 
- Set quality standards for API design, system performance, scalability, and reliability. 
- Lead cross-functional coordination with design, engineering, QA, support, data, and legal to deliver on-time, high-quality launches. 
- Represent the needs of agencies, sub-accounts, and end contacts in platform and CRM decisions — ensuring we build with deep user empathy. 
- Collaborate with the Product leadership to influence org-wide product strategy, culture, and planning cadences.
- Lead strategic quarterly and annual planning for the org — bringing clarity to priorities across technical debt, product innovation, and user experience. 
- Act as a thought partner to engineering leadership in shaping architecture and development investment decisions.
 
What Success Looks Like
- HighLevel’s platform teams are recognised as enablers, not blockers — other pods build faster using your team's APIs, patterns, and systems. 
- CRM primitives and workflows become more reliable, performant, and deeply adopted by our users — visible in activation and retention metrics. 
- The organization experiences clean product ownership, predictable roadmaps, and fast decision-making under your leadership. 
- Workflow AI and Workflow Core support a growing number of use cases without sacrificing speed, reliability, or clarity. 
- The data model becomes flexible and extensible, enabling custom objects, relationships, and analytics without friction. 
- You are viewed as a strategic thought partners and executional anchor for platform and core products at HighLevel
 
Ideal Candidate Profile
- 12–15+ years in product management, with at least 5+ years managing managers (GPMs,Directors or equivalents).
- Experience scaling platform and core product orgs in fast-growth B2B SaaS companies, (ideally between $500M-$1B ARR).
- Deep fluency in CRM, automation platforms, or workflow engines — understands data models, APIs, and system-level product thinking. 
- Prior experience building internal platforms or developer tools that support multiple product teams. 
- Ability to scale orgs, implement processes, and hire/coach high-performing PMs. 
- Technical fluency — capable of earning trust with engineering leads and making calls on infra trade-offs, architecture, and scalability. 
- Familiar with two-tier SaaS, multi-tenant environments, and role-based access control models. 
- Strong written and asynchronous communication skills — capable of driving clarity across functions and time zones.
 
Bonus Points For
- Experience working on workflow builders, CRM platforms, or marketing automation tools.
- Background in B2B2SMB or agency-led SaaS models. 
- Exposure to design systems, shared component libraries, or analytics platforms. 
- Hands-on familiarity with platform performance metrics (e.g., P95 latency, Sentry, Grafana).
- Experience integrating with third-party platforms like Stripe, Meta, Google, or TikTok (even if not leading monetization).

About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
Who Are You
The People Technology Integration Specialist is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining secure, scalable integrations across the People Technology ecosystem. This role acts as the technical backbone of interoperability between Darwinbox and external platforms (ADP, Netsuite, Snowflake, Shareworks, Slack, etc.), ensuring clean data flow, schema governance, and operational continuity.
Unlike configuration-heavy roles, this position requires strong integration architecture thinking combined with hands-on execution across APIs, data mapping, transformation logic, and validation frameworks.
What You Will Do:
1. Integration Architecture & Design
•Define Integration Blueprint: Design end-to-end integration architecture across the People Technology ecosystem - connecting Darwinbox with IT, Payroll, FP&A, Equity, EOR (Employer of Record) systems and other complementing platforms; ensuring scalability, compliance, and a seamless experience across the employee lifecycle.
• Data Mapping & Schema Governance: Own field-level mapping, transformation logic, code harmonization (e.g., cost centers, departments, job codes), and schema documentation across all integrated systems.
•Business-to-Technical Translation: Translate Functional requirements into structured integration specifications with clearly defined data contracts that serve downstream consumers.
2. API Configuration & Data Flow Management
• API & Middleware Configuration: Configure and manage Darwinbox APIs, webhooks, SFTP feeds, and Amplify scripts to ensure secure, accurate, and timely data transformations and transfers across the ecosystem.
•Build & Maintain Analytics-Ready Feeds: Design statistical and headcount feeds into Snowflake and financial planning feeds into Abacum, ensuring aggregation logic is compliant, audit-safe, and structured for downstream consumption.
•Integration Enhancements: Maintain and enhance integrations by leveraging lifecycle event triggers, eligibility syncs, and reconciliation workflows.
• Environment & Version Control: Manage sandbox vs. production configurations, schema versioning, and release readiness across all integration environments.
3. Monitoring, Controls & Incident Management
• Proactive Monitoring: Monitor daily integration syncs, overnight jobs, and scheduled feeds across all connected platforms for failures or discrepancies.
•Exception Handling & Root Cause Analysis: Investigate and resolve integration failures (e.g., invalid codes, duplicate IDs, missing mandatory fields) with a focus on preventing recurrence across the ecosystem.
•Audit & ITGC Compliance: Ensure maker-checker controls, validation logs, and change management documentation are maintained for compliance and audit purposes across all integrated systems.
4. Data Integrity & Cross-System Alignment
•Master Data Governance: Ensure consistency of core attributes across Darwinbox and all downstream systems.
•Org Structure & Payroll Alignment: Support large-scale changes such as org restructures by remapping integration logic and validating downstream impact across the full ecosystem.
•Preventive Controls Design: Implement validation logic to prevent sync failures and data drift, ensuring the integrity of the integrated people data ecosystem at all times.
5. Documentation & Cross-Functional Enablement
•Integration Documentation: Maintain up-to-date technical documentation including data dictionaries, integration logic, transformation rules, system architecture diagrams, and process flows across the ecosystem.
•Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the integration point of contact for Finance, Payroll, Equity, IT, and HRBPs - translating technical constraints into business impact and vice versa.
•Knowledge Transfer: Enable People Tech team members and cross-functional partners to understand integration dependencies, data lineage, and downstream impacts across all connected platforms.
What You Bring:
• 5 years of experience in HRIS integrations, People systems architecture, or payroll ecosystem integrations.
• Hands-on experience working with Darwinbox APIs, data extracts, integration schemas, and lifecycle changes.
•Experience integrating with payroll, IT, Finance platforms with understanding of GL logic, cost allocation, and statistical feeds.
• Strong capability in designing field mappings, transformation logic, schema validation, and reconciliation frameworks.
• Familiarity with ITGC, audit compliance, access governance, and integration change control practices.

Role Summary
As the Sr. Product Manager for Commerce Operations, you will own the operational backbone of HighLevel's commerce platform - the interconnected systems that govern how orders are created, tracked, and fulfilled; how subscriptions run across their full lifecycle; how transactions are recorded and reconciled; and how inventory, taxation, coupons, and gift cards function reliably at scale. Like the Product Information Management layer, this role sits at the center of the Commerce team: every commerce surface depends on it, internal teams across the company build on it, and the external developer and marketplace ecosystem consumes it through a public API layer that you will define and own. You will also lead the build of HighLevel's internal accounting layer and design the integration surface for users who operate with third-party accounting tools — positioning commerce operations as both the authoritative source of financial truth and an open, compatible platform.

What You'll Do

● Own the Commerce Operations Roadmap: Define and drive the end-to-end product vision across HighLevel's full operations surface - Orders, Subscriptions, Transactions, Inventory, Fulfillment, Taxation, Coupons, and Gift Cards — ensuring each domain is built as a composable, reliable primitive that serves the platform as a whole.

● Build the Subscription Lifecycle: Own how plans, entitlements, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, pauses, and dunning flows work across the platform - building subscription management that handles the full complexity of real SMB billing, from simple recurring charges to tiered, usage-based, and trial-gated plans.

● Define the Ledger & Internal Accounting Layer: Lead the product definition and build of HighLevel's internal accounting layer — the authoritative system of record for every money-in and money-out event - designed from day one as the foundation for embedded accounting that keeps businesses running their books inside HighLevel.

● Enable Third-Party Accounting Compatibility: Design the integration surface that allows users who prefer external accounting software to sync HighLevel commerce data seamlessly - ensuring field mapping accuracy, reconciliation reliability, and a sync experience that requires zero manual intervention.

● Own Order Management & Fulfillment: Define how orders are created, modified, fulfilled, partially fulfilled, returned, and cancelled - building the state machine and merchant-facing workflows that make order operations reliable across every commerce surface, from storefronts to invoices to subscriptions.

● Build for Variable Granularity: Ensure every operational entity - order, fulfillment event, invoice, subscription, payment — is optional and composable. A business running on invoices alone and a business running a full order-fulfillment-invoice-payment chain must both be fully supported, with frictionless paths between granularity levels.

● Lead Inventory Management: Define the inventory layer - stock levels, reservations, adjustments, multi-location support, and low-stock signals - ensuring the platform correctly tracks physical goods across the full commerce lifecycle and exposes inventory state to every consuming surface.

● Shape Taxation & Compliance Infrastructure: Own the product strategy for tax calculation, tax code mapping, and compliance — across transaction types and geographies - ensuring HighLevel handles tax obligations correctly as merchants operate in multiple regions and as the platform expands internationally.

● Define Coupons, Promotions & Gift Cards: Build the discount and gift card infrastructure - coupon creation and validation, promotion rules, gift card issuance and redemption, balance tracking - ensuring these tools are expressive enough for merchant needs while enforcing correct financial accounting at every step.

● Own the Developer & Marketplace API Surface: Define and own the public API layer that external developers, agencies, and marketplace partners consume - ensuring commerce operations APIs are well-designed, stable, versioned, and expressive enough to support the full range of third-party integration and build use cases.

● Drive Cross-Functional Platform Alignment: Collaborate with the PIM, Documents, Onboarding, and Payments teams to ensure the operations layer exposes the primitives they depend on - and that operational events such as order placement, invoice issuance, and subscription renewal trigger the correct downstream behaviors reliably and consistently.

What We're Looking For

● 7+ Years of PM Experience: Proven track record in platform or infrastructure product management at high-growth SaaS companies, with significant exposure to transactional or financial systems.

● Commerce Operations Depth: Deep familiarity with order management, subscription billing, inventory, fulfillment, and transaction or ledger systems - understanding both the underlying data models and the merchant workflows built on top of them.

● Financial Systems Fluency: Comfort reasoning about ledger mechanics, double-entry accounting concepts, reconciliation requirements, and the data integrity standards of systems that carry financial truth for real businesses.

● API & Developer Platform Thinking: Experience building and owning public APIs consumed by external developers — with a strong grasp of contract design, versioning strategies, stability guarantees, and what makes a developer experience genuinely good.

● Platform-First Mindset: Demonstrated ability to design products as shared infrastructure - defining clear contracts, managing internal teams as stakeholders, and consistently prioritizing long-term extensibility over short-term feature velocity.

● Bias for Ownership: Comfortable holding the thread across a broad, interconnected domain without letting complexity become an excuse for slow decisions. Sets direction and drives execution independently.

What you'll get

● Strategic Centrality: Own the operational core that every other commerce surface depends on - a role with platform-wide impact, visibility across every team building on HighLevel's commerce infrastructure, and a direct line to the company's system-of-record ambition.

● High Ownership, Low Bureaucracy: Join an already-assembled engineering and design team and take full ownership of a mission-critical layer, with the autonomy to define the roadmap and drive execution at the pace HighLevel operates.

● Scale: Build the operational infrastructure that powers commerce for over a million businesses across 150+ countries, and define the accounting and developer API layer that will shape how HighLevel's commerce ecosystem grows over the next decade.

What We're Looking For

About the team
The Lead Generation Team is responsible for shaping how millions of SMBs create high-converting digital experiences using HighLevel. Our mission is to empower businesses with world-class tools for publishing websites and funnels, capturing leads, tracking user behavior, and optimizing conversions with data.
We own key product pillars including Website Builder, Funnel Builder, Tracking Events, Analytics Dashboard, Media, Custom Widgets, Forms, and Surveys. Our charter includes driving product innovation, improving user activation, enhancing performance and reliability, and enabling agencies to deliver exceptional web experiences for their clients. As we scale globally, we are doubling down on real-time analytics, AI-powered insights, event-level behavioral tracking, and seamless user journeys across funnels and websites.
Alongside these core pillars, the team also owns Domains — the foundation that takes every site and funnel live. This includes domain search and purchase, automated DNS and SSL setup, domain connection and verification, and transfer workflows (including Cloudflare Registrar integration), ensuring a smooth, friction-free publishing experience across all customer-facing assets.
Why should you join HighLevel?
HighLevel is an exciting place to work because of the passionate, driven team that we have. At HighLevel:
It's never somebody else's job
We are passionately focussed on adding value for our users
We deliver fast using lean principles. We go to market in weeks instead of quarters
A good idea always gets tested
We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users
We embrace that improvement is constant and iterative
You will learn how to scale a B2B SaaS Startup and build relevant, impactful products for customers
About the role
HighLevel is seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to lead our suite of lead generation products — including the Website Builder, Funnel Builder, Analytics, Tracking Events, and the Domains experience that brings those sites and funnels live. This role is ideal for a product leader passionate about empowering agencies to build beautiful, performant digital experiences and understand user behavior through deep analytics and event instrumentation.
You will own the strategy and roadmap for the next-generation lead generation experience, including:
Building world-class lead generation products competitive with top platforms in the space.
Designing event-level tracking systems for clicks, scrolls, form interactions, media engagement, bookings, and more.
Leveraging AI to provide recommendations, automate design decisions, and enhance product workflows.
Ensuring a seamless path from creation to publish connecting the building experience to reliable domain purchasing, DNS, and SSL setup.
This is a high-impact role where you will shape the future of how SMBs generate leads and build online experiences on HighLevel.
Your Responsibilities
Strategy & discovery
Establish a long-term strategy for HighLevel's lead generation products, including the Website Builder, Funnel Builder, Tracking Events, and supporting Domains experience. Align the roadmap with customer needs, business goals, and emerging market trends in web creation and analytics.
Lead discovery, research, requirements, prioritization, execution, and iteration across all lead generation capabilities.
Conduct user interviews, analyze behavioral data, identify user pain points, and convert insights into clear product requirements and user stories.
Product, analytics & tracking
Define event taxonomy, enhance tracking systems, and evolve analytics dashboards to help users understand traffic, conversions, and on-page behavior.
Improve speed, templates, design flexibility, mobile responsiveness, AI-assisted features, media management, and plugin/widget capabilities across the lead generation products.
Work on solutions that help agencies scale — bulk actions, reusable components, collaboration capabilities, white-label optimizations, and AI-powered enhancements.
Define and monitor product metrics such as adoption, activation, conversion events, performance, and engagement. Use data to size opportunities and validate outcomes.
Publishing & domains (supporting)
Own the publish-to-live experience across the lead generation suite: domain search, purchase, and provisioning, with automated DNS and SSL workflows that reduce manual complexity for users.
Improve domain reliability and transfer workflows, working with registrar APIs (e.g., Cloudflare) to expand TLD support, while ensuring compliance with ICANN and registrar-level requirements.
Execution & measurement
Partner closely with engineering, design, data, GTM, and support teams to drive execution, uplift user activation, and deliver high-quality features on schedule.
Present product plans, progress, and updates. Act as a subject matter expert for lead generation products across internal teams and with customers.
Experience
6+ years of Product Management experience in SaaS, website builders, marketing tech, analytics platforms, or similar domains.
Strong understanding of website creation tools, funnel builders, conversion optimization, and digital marketing workflows.
Familiarity with user behavior tracking (clicks, scrolls, heatmaps, form submissions, media events, etc.) and experience with data pipelines, analytics, or telemetry.
Experience building LLM-based or AI-driven products and familiarity with evaluation frameworks, monitoring, or instrumentation.
Strong UX and front-end sensibility, with strong UI/UX sensibilities and the ability to work closely with designers.
Experience collaborating with engineering teams on complex frontend + backend product builds.
Exposure to or interest in AI-driven workflows, LLM-powered assistants, and generative UI systems.
Familiarity with hosting, DNS, or domain infrastructure is a plus.
Proven ability to drive strategy, prioritize effectively, and deliver with ownership.
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
 

About the team

The Lead Generation Team is responsible for shaping how millions of SMBs create high-converting digital experiences using HighLevel. Our mission is to empower businesses with world-class tools for publishing websites and funnels, capturing leads, tracking user behavior, and optimizing conversions with data.

We own key product pillars including Website Builder, Funnel Builder, Tracking Events, Analytics Dashboard, Media, Custom Widgets, Forms, and Surveys. Our charter includes driving product innovation, improving user activation, enhancing performance and reliability, and enabling agencies to deliver exceptional web experiences for their clients. As we scale globally, we are doubling down on real-time analytics, AI-powered insights, event-level behavioral tracking, and seamless user journeys across funnels and websites.

Alongside these core pillars, the team also owns Domains — the foundation that takes every site and funnel live. This includes domain search and purchase, automated DNS and SSL setup, domain connection and verification, and transfer workflows (including Cloudflare Registrar integration), ensuring a smooth, friction-free publishing experience across all customer-facing assets.

Why should you join HighLevel?

HighLevel is an exciting place to work because of the passionate, driven team that we have. At HighLevel:

  • It's never somebody else's job

  • We are passionately focussed on adding value for our users

  • We deliver fast using lean principles. We go to market in weeks instead of quarters

  • A good idea always gets tested

  • We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users

  • We embrace that improvement is constant and iterative

  • You will learn how to scale a B2B SaaS Startup and build relevant, impactful products for customers

About the role

HighLevel is seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to lead our suite of lead generation products — including the Website Builder, Funnel Builder, Analytics, Tracking Events, and the Domains experience that brings those sites and funnels live. This role is ideal for a product leader passionate about empowering agencies to build beautiful, performant digital experiences and understand user behavior through deep analytics and event instrumentation.

You will own the strategy and roadmap for the next-generation lead generation experience, including:

  • Building world-class lead generation products competitive with top platforms in the space.

  • Designing event-level tracking systems for clicks, scrolls, form interactions, media engagement, bookings, and more.

  • Leveraging AI to provide recommendations, automate design decisions, and enhance product workflows.

  • Ensuring a seamless path from creation to publish connecting the building experience to reliable domain purchasing, DNS, and SSL setup.

This is a high-impact role where you will shape the future of how SMBs generate leads and build online experiences on HighLevel.

Your Responsibilities

Strategy & discovery

  • Establish a long-term strategy for HighLevel's lead generation products, including the Website Builder, Funnel Builder, Tracking Events, and supporting Domains experience. Align the roadmap with customer needs, business goals, and emerging market trends in web creation and analytics.

  • Lead discovery, research, requirements, prioritization, execution, and iteration across all lead generation capabilities.

  • Conduct user interviews, analyze behavioral data, identify user pain points, and convert insights into clear product requirements and user stories.

Product, analytics & tracking

  • Define event taxonomy, enhance tracking systems, and evolve analytics dashboards to help users understand traffic, conversions, and on-page behavior.

  • Improve speed, templates, design flexibility, mobile responsiveness, AI-assisted features, media management, and plugin/widget capabilities across the lead generation products.

  • Work on solutions that help agencies scale — bulk actions, reusable components, collaboration capabilities, white-label optimizations, and AI-powered enhancements.

  • Define and monitor product metrics such as adoption, activation, conversion events, performance, and engagement. Use data to size opportunities and validate outcomes.

Publishing & domains (supporting)

  • Own the publish-to-live experience across the lead generation suite: domain search, purchase, and provisioning, with automated DNS and SSL workflows that reduce manual complexity for users.

  • Improve domain reliability and transfer workflows, working with registrar APIs (e.g., Cloudflare) to expand TLD support, while ensuring compliance with ICANN and registrar-level requirements.

Execution & measurement

  • Partner closely with engineering, design, data, GTM, and support teams to drive execution, uplift user activation, and deliver high-quality features on schedule.

  • Present product plans, progress, and updates. Act as a subject matter expert for lead generation products across internal teams and with customers.

Experience

  • 6+ years of Product Management experience in SaaS, website builders, marketing tech, analytics platforms, or similar domains.

  • Strong understanding of website creation tools, funnel builders, conversion optimization, and digital marketing workflows.

  • Familiarity with user behavior tracking (clicks, scrolls, heatmaps, form submissions, media events, etc.) and experience with data pipelines, analytics, or telemetry.

  • Experience building LLM-based or AI-driven products and familiarity with evaluation frameworks, monitoring, or instrumentation.

  • Strong UX and front-end sensibility, with strong UI/UX sensibilities and the ability to work closely with designers.

  • Experience collaborating with engineering teams on complex frontend + backend product builds.

  • Exposure to or interest in AI-driven workflows, LLM-powered assistants, and generative UI systems.

  • Familiarity with hosting, DNS, or domain infrastructure is a plus.

  • Proven ability to drive strategy, prioritize effectively, and deliver with ownership.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Product:HighLevel’s Phone Platform powers the communication infrastructure used by millions of businesses across our ecosystem. The platform enables businesses to acquire and manage phone numbers, send and receive messages, make and receive calls, track communication usage, and monetize communication services at scale.The product sits at the intersection of communications, billing, and platform infrastructure, supporting voice, SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, and future communication channels across multiple global providers. It is responsible for ensuring reliable message and call delivery, intelligent routing, account provisioning, usage metering, billing accuracy, compliance, and profitability.As HighLevel continues to expand globally, the Phone Platform plays a critical role in delivering scalable communication capabilities, optimizing costs, improving margins, and enabling new monetization opportunities for agencies and businesses worldwide. The team operates at the core of HighLevel’s growth engine, building products that directly impact customer adoption, platform revenue, and overall business performance.

Role Overview:As a Senior Product Manager for Phone Platform, you will partner closely with the Product Leadership to drive the strategy, execution and growth of HighLevel’s communication and monetisation platform.You will play a critical role in shaping and delivering products across voice, messaging, billing, pricing and account lifecycle management while ensuring alignment with company goals, customer needs and business outcomes. This role requires a strong operator who can move seamlessly between roadmap planning, customer discovery, go-to-market execution, pricing strategy and hands-on product delivery.You will collaborate with Engineering, Design, Finance, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to bring new platform capabilities to market, optimise monetisation, and improve the reliability and scalability of HighLevel’s communications ecosystem.This is an ideal role for a product manager who combines strong execution skills with commercial thinking and enjoys working on technically complex products that directly impact customer growth, platform economics, and company revenue.

Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Execution
Partner with product leadership to define and execute the roadmap for HighLevel’s CPaaS, Billing and Phone Platform products.
Translate strategic objectives into actionable product plans, milestones and measurable outcomes.
Be part of the team driving end-to-end product development from discovery and validation through launch and post-release optimisation.
Own roadmap grooming, prioritization, backlog management and sprint planning activities across multiple initiatives.
Collaborate closely with Engineering and Design to deliver scalable, high-quality platform capabilities.
 Communication Platform & Billing
Contribute to the evolution of HighLevel’s communications infrastructure, including messaging, voice, number management, routing and usage tracking.
Define and improve billing workflows, usage metering, reconciliation processes and customer-facing billing experiences.
Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations to ensure billing accuracy, margin visibility and operational efficiency.
Support initiatives related to provider management, routing optimization, cost reduction and service reliability.

 Pricing & Monetization
Develop and maintain pricing strategies across communication products and platform services.
Analyze usage patterns, customer segments, margins and competitive positioning to recommend pricing improvements.
Partner with Finance and Leadership to evaluate monetization opportunities and business cases for new products and features.
Define success metrics and monitor revenue, adoption, retention, and profitability performance.

Go-To-Market & Product Launches
Partner with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Enablement teams to develop and execute go-to-market strategies.
Own launch planning, product positioning inputs, packaging recommendations, and rollout strategies.
Create and maintain product documentation, launch materials and internal enablement resources.
Measure launch performance and drive continuous improvements based on customer feedback and business results.

Data & Customer Insights
Use customer feedback, usage analytics, experimentation, and market research to inform product decisions.
Define and track key KPIs related to adoption, engagement, revenue, billing accuracy, delivery performance, and customer satisfaction.
Investigate product performance, operational issues, and growth opportunities through data-driven analysis.
Conduct customer interviews and collaborate with stakeholders to identify unmet needs and validate solutions.

Cross-Functional Leadership
Drive alignment on priorities, dependencies, timelines and business objectives.
Help establish best practices for product management, planning, execution, and operational excellence.

Requirement:
7+ years of Product Management experience in SaaS, platform, fintech, telecom, CPaaS or related technology environments.
Proven track record of shipping and scaling customer-facing and platform products from concept to launch.
Experience managing product roadmaps, prioritisation frameworks, and cross-functional delivery processes.
Strong understanding of product discovery, customer research, experimentation, and data-driven decision making.
Experience developing go-to-market plans and partnering with Marketing, Sales and Customer Success teams on successful product launches.
Demonstrated experience working on pricing, packaging, monetisation, or usage-based business models.
Ability to balance customer needs, technical constraints, and business objectives when making product decisions.
Strong analytical skills with experience leveraging SQL, BI tools, dashboards, or product analytics platforms.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments with multiple concurrent initiatives.
Strong ownership mindset with a bias toward execution, accountability and measurable outcomes.

Nice-to-Have
Experience with CPaaS, telecommunications, messaging, voice platforms, or communication infrastructure products.
Familiarity with usage-based billing systems, reconciliation processes, and subscription monetization models.
Experience working with pricing optimization, margin analysis and revenue growth initiatives.
Knowledge of communication providers, carrier ecosystems, routing frameworks, and messaging compliance requirements.
Experience with Chargebee, Stripe Billing, NetSuite, or similar billing and financial systems.
Strong technical fluency around APIs, event-driven systems, data pipelines, and platform architectures.
Experience operating in remote, globally distributed teams.
Prior experience in high-growth B2B SaaS companies serving SMBs, agencies, or enterprise customers.
