ProductMessaging is the highest-volume communication channel on HighLevel's Phone Platform, and RCS (Rich Communication Services) represents its next major evolution. RCS upgrades the SMS experience into a branded, interactive, app-like channel: verified senders, rich cards, carousels, suggested replies, high-resolution media, read receipts, and typing indicators, delivered natively in the default messaging app on both Android and iOS.HighLevel's RCS product sits at the intersection of channel strategy, carrier and aggregator ecosystems, compliance, and monetization. It spans sender/agent registration and brand verification, rich message composition and templating, intelligent SMS/MMS fallback orchestration, delivery and engagement analytics, and usage-based pricing. As RCS reaches general availability across our ecosystem, this product line is central to how millions of businesses differentiate their customer conversations, and to how HighLevel grows messaging revenue, engagement, and retention across the platform.
Role Overview
As Senior Product Manager for RCS & Rich Messaging, you will own the strategy, execution, and growth of HighLevel's RCS product line, from sender onboarding and carrier readiness through rich messaging experiences, fallback logic, analytics, market expansion, and monetization.This is a channel-ownership role with platform-level scope. You will define what "great RCS" looks like for agencies and SMBs, drive adoption from early GA to mainstream usage, expand RCS availability into new markets and regions, and shape how rich messaging interoperates with SMS, MMS, and future conversational channels. You will work deeply with the carrier and aggregator ecosystem (Google RBM, messaging aggregators, and downstream providers) and translate a fast-moving standards landscape into a reliable, compliant, revenue-generating product.You will collaborate with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to bring RCS capabilities to market, reduce onboarding friction, and build the business case and pricing architecture for rich messaging at scale.This role is ideal for a product manager who combines strong execution with commercial judgment, is comfortable operating in an emerging ecosystem where the rules are still being written, and wants to own a channel with clear line of sight to platform revenue.
Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Channel Ownership
Own the end-to-end RCS roadmap: sender registration and verification, rich messaging capabilities, fallback orchestration, analytics, market expansion, and pricing.
Define the adoption strategy for RCS across the customer base, including segmentation, activation triggers, and migration paths from SMS/MMS.
Track the evolving RCS ecosystem (carrier launches, Google RBM capabilities, Apple/iOS support, aggregator offerings, regional availability) and translate it into roadmap decisions.
Establish where RCS wins versus SMS, MMS, and WhatsApp, and where it does not, and encode that judgment into product defaults and customer guidance.
Market Expansion
Own the RCS market expansion roadmap: assess carrier readiness, device penetration, regulatory requirements, and commercial viability by country and region.
Define launch criteria and phased rollout plans for new markets, including provider selection, pricing localization, and compliance requirements per region.
Partner with aggregators and providers to secure coverage, favorable economics, and reliable delivery in target markets.
Prioritize market entry based on addressable customer base, messaging volume potential, unit economics, and competitive positioning.
Coordinate cross-functional readiness for each market launch across Engineering, Compliance, Billing, Support, and Go-To-Market teams.
Onboarding, Registration & Compliance
Own and continuously improve the RCS sender/agent registration and brand verification experience, minimizing time-to-first-message and approval friction.
Partner with Compliance and carrier/aggregator partners on messaging policy, content requirements, opt-in/opt-out standards, and verification workflows.
Design safeguards and review processes that protect deliverability and sender reputation as volume scales.
Rich Messaging Experience
Define the composition, templating, and campaign experiences for rich cards, carousels, suggested replies/actions, and media messaging.
Own fallback logic and channel orchestration, ensuring graceful degradation to SMS/MMS with predictable cost, formatting, and delivery behavior.
Partner with Design to make rich messaging accessible to non-technical SMB users, not just sophisticated senders.
Monetization & Business Performance
Develop and maintain RCS pricing and packaging, including per-message and conversation-based models, in partnership with Finance and Leadership.
Analyze unit economics across providers, message types, and markets; own margin visibility and cost-optimization opportunities for the channel.
Define and track success metrics: sender activation, message volume, engagement (read/interaction rates), revenue, margin, and retention impact.
Build business cases for channel expansion, new capabilities, and regional rollouts.
Go-To-Market & Adoption
Partner with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Enablement on positioning, launch planning, packaging recommendations, and rollout strategy.
Create and maintain product documentation, launch materials, and internal enablement resources.
Drive post-launch iteration based on adoption data, customer feedback, and engagement performance.
Data & Customer Insights
Use usage analytics, experimentation, customer interviews, and market research to inform product decisions.
Investigate delivery performance, engagement patterns, and adoption blockers through data-driven analysis.
Define instrumentation requirements so engagement and delivery analytics are first-class product surfaces for customers, not just internal telemetry.
Requirements
7+ years of Product Management experience in SaaS, CPaaS, telecom, platform, or related technology environments.
Proven track record of shipping and scaling customer-facing products from concept to launch, ideally including a product in an emerging or fast-evolving ecosystem.
Strong understanding of messaging channels and their economics (SMS/MMS at minimum; RCS, WhatsApp, or other rich/conversational channels strongly preferred).
Demonstrated experience with pricing, packaging, monetization, or usage-based business models.
Experience navigating external partner ecosystems, such as carriers, aggregators, platform providers, or comparable third parties whose roadmaps constrain your own.
Experience launching or expanding products into new markets or regions, including readiness assessment and phased rollouts.
Strong analytical skills with experience leveraging SQL, BI tools, dashboards, or product analytics platforms.
Ability to balance customer needs, technical constraints, compliance requirements, and business objectives in product decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Strong ownership mindset with a bias toward execution, accountability, and measurable outcomes.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments with multiple concurrent initiatives.
Nice-to-Have
Direct experience with RCS Business Messaging (Google RBM), agent registration, or rich messaging products.
Knowledge of A2P messaging compliance, sender registration frameworks (e.g., 10DLC), carrier ecosystems, and deliverability management.
Familiarity with messaging aggregators and multi-provider routing architectures.
Experience with channel fallback/orchestration logic across SMS, MMS, RCS, or OTT channels.
Experience with international messaging markets, regional carrier ecosystems, or global provider negotiations.
Experience with usage-based billing systems, margin analysis, and revenue growth initiatives.
Strong technical fluency around APIs, webhooks, event-driven systems, and platform architectures.
Experience operating in remote, globally distributed teams.
Prior experience in high-growth B2B SaaS companies serving SMBs, agencies, or enterprise customers.
Why Join HighLevel?
At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

EEO StatementThe company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application#LI-Remote #LI-MP1

Role Overview
We’re looking for an Sr. UX Researcher to help elevate the quality, consistency, and impact of user experience across our product ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of design execution, research, and product thinking—supporting the UX and product team in raising the bar while ensuring our experiences are intuitive, competitive, and customer-centric.
You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to identify opportunities, analyze competitive experiences, and drive continuous UX improvement. This is an ideal role for someone who is both detail-oriented and strategic—someone who can zoom in on interaction design while also zooming out to understand market trends and user needs.
What You’ll Do
Raise the UX bar across the product by identifying gaps in usability, consistency, and polish, and proactively driving improvements across key surfaces.
Conduct competitive research and audits to understand how leading products solve similar problems, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
Partner with product managers and designers to shape user flows, refine interactions, and ensure strong UX fundamentals are embedded early in the product development process.
Synthesize user feedback and data from multiple sources (support tickets, usability tests, analytics) to identify recurring pain points and opportunities.
Drive UX consistency and standards by contributing to design systems, pattern libraries, and best practices that scale across teams.
Support usability testing and research efforts by helping define hypotheses, structuring studies, and translating findings into clear product direction.
Create clear UX documentation and artifacts including wireframes, journey maps, and experience audits that inform decision-making.
Advocate for the user across the organization by grounding conversations in user needs, behaviors, and outcomes.
What We’re Looking For
3–6 years of experience in UX, product design, or related fields, with a strong understanding of user-centered design principles.
Strong customer and product intuition, with the ability to evaluate experiences and identify both obvious and non-obvious usability issues.
Experience conducting competitive analysis and UX audits, with the ability to turn observations into structured insights.

We're hiring our first Staff Data Scientist, Experimentation & Causal Inference to define how HighLevel learns from experiments and turns results into trustworthy product decisions and business strategy. Our teams ship fast and have started experimenting to make data-backed decisions; you'll bring the rigor and consistency to scale that across the company.

You'll set the company-wide standard for experiment design and causal inference, embed it in how the product gets built, and coach PMs and analysts to run tests that hold up. You'll do this in a fast-moving, multi-product SaaS/CRM environment where samples are small, many products move at once, and a wrong "win" is costly. This is a founding, hands-on IC role with executive sponsorship and a path to build out a Data Science team as the function matures.

• Define the end-to-end methodology every team follows - hypothesis → metrics → design → power → readout → decision - and make it the default
  • Own the statistical approach (significance, multiple comparisons, sequential testing, variance reduction like CUPED) for small-sample, fast-paced contexts where classic A/B power is hard to reach
  • Build the methods toolkit for our clustered, hierarchical data (user → sub-account/location → agency), where randomization and analysis units differ
  • Apply rigorous causal inference (matching, diff-in-diff, instrumental variables, synthetic control, etc) when clean experiments aren't feasible - churn, onboarding, GTM - separating real signal from selection bias, seasonality, and mix effects
  • Own the design discipline for running many experiments at once - layering, orthogonal experiments, holdouts, and guardrails that keep concurrent tests from contaminating each other
  • Partner with AI/ML teams to design and evaluate experiments for AI features, including measurement for non-deterministic, fast-iterating systems
  • Run the experiment review forum and hold the line on what counts as a real result
  • Build the Experimentation curriculum and templates that level up PMs and analysts so good design scales beyond you
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on governed, experiment-ready data and consistent metric definitions
  • Influence leadership and cross-functional partners on where to invest, translating statistical nuance into clear, decision-grade guidance

• 9+ years in data science, product analytics, or applied statistics, with deep hands-on experience designing and analyzing online controlled experiments at scale
  • Strong applied statistics - frequentist foundations, Bayesian methods, power analysis, variance reduction, and the failure modes of A/B testing (peeking, multiple testing, network/cluster effects)
  • Practical causal inference, with sound judgment about when a result is causal versus an artifact of how the data was generated
  • Experience in small-sample, fast-paced, multi-product environments -you know when a decision needs a clean experiment and when it needs a fast, good-enough read
  • Strong SQL and working proficiency in Python or R
  • Cross-functional and senior-leadership influence - you raise others' experiment quality without direct authority

• Familiarity with a modern experimentation platform such as Statsig
  • Experience building an experimentation practice or culture from the ground up
  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or product-led growth, and familiarity with the measurement challenges these motions create
  • Multi-tenant or marketplace product experience (agency → sub-account → end-customer structures)

About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

As a Staff Engineer on the Platform Engineering team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the foundation of HighLevel’s platform. You’ll design and develop shared frameworks, libraries, and core services that power products at scale. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive in ambiguity, enjoy solving large-scale engineering challenges, and are passionate about building systems that enable massive impact across teams.

The Staff Engineer is expected to be a deeply technical engineering leader who thrives in ambiguity, takes extreme ownership, and has proven experience designing and building highly scalable, complex distributed systems at scale. You will also help drive engineering excellence through effective adoption of AI-powered development workflows and systems that improve software development lifecycle (SDLC) efficiency, developer productivity, quality, and delivery velocity.

• Architect, develop, and maintain reusable frameworks, SDKs, and core platform services using Node.js and GoLang
  • Build scalable, cloud-native solutions leveraging Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Design and optimize systems that efficiently handle large-scale data and high-throughput workloads
  • Contribute to high-performance service architectures capable of handling massive scale with strong reliability and observability standards
  • Lead technical design reviews, establish engineering best practices, and mentor senior engineers across teams
  • Drive architectural decisions for scalability, performance, security, and maintainability
  • Partner cross-functionally with product, infrastructure, and engineering teams to deliver reliable platform capabilities
  • Improve developer productivity by building internal tooling, shared libraries, and scalable engineering foundations
  • Lead initiatives that leverage AI effectively across engineering workflows, including code generation, testing, developer tooling, incident analysis, and SDLC automation
  • Build and evolve systems, platforms, and engineering processes that improve SDLC efficiency, release velocity, reliability, and developer experience
  • Take ownership of critical platform initiatives from architecture through production operations

• 9+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated success building distributed systems or large-scale backend services
  • Hands-on experience designing, optimizing, and scaling large-scale backend systems and data-intensive applications
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and observability frameworks
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering workflows and building systems/processes that improve SDLC effectiveness and engineering productivity
  • Proven ability to lead technically, navigate ambiguity, and deliver impactful engineering outcomes
  • Experience operating systems at high scale with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and resiliency
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to simplify complex technical challenges

• Experience building internal platforms, frameworks, or developer tooling used across multiple teams
  • Strong expertise in Node.js/GoLang and cloud infrastructure, preferably GCP
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, service mesh technologies, and infrastructure automation
  • Experience in high-traffic SaaS environments with a focus on scalability and resilience
  • Exposure to event-driven architectures, streaming systems, or large-scale data platforms
  • Experience evaluating or implementing AI-enabled developer platforms, coding assistants, or SDLC automation systems

Role OverviewAs the Staff Product Manager for Agency Revenue Growth, you will own the vision, strategy, and outcomes for HighLevel's Agency Revenue Suite. Your mission is to help agencies launch, grow, and scale successful SaaS businesses by creating seamless experiences across SaaS Mode, Reselling, Rebilling, and the broader agency revenue ecosystem.This role requires a strong blend of product strategy, growth expertise, customer empathy, and analytical rigor. You will drive measurable improvements in onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, and agency revenue while establishing the systems, metrics, and experimentation frameworks that enable sustainable growth at scale.You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Analytics, Marketing, Revenue, and Customer Success teams to identify opportunities, align priorities, and deliver measurable business impact.
Key Responsibilities
Own the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for the Agency Revenue Suite, driving growth across SaaS Mode, Reselling, Rebilling, and the overall agency revenue experience.

Create a unified experience that enables agencies to launch, monetize, and scale successful SaaS businesses on HighLevel.

Define and own the measurement strategy for the Agency Revenue Suite, including instrumentation, reporting, customer health frameworks, and key SaaS metrics across activation, adoption, retention, expansion, churn, and agency revenue performance.

Drive measurable improvements in onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion by identifying opportunities through customer behavior, product analytics, and experimentation.

Partner with Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering teams to develop growth insights, customer health models, churn prediction frameworks, dashboards, and scalable measurement systems that inform product decisions.

Establish and scale experimentation frameworks, feedback loops, and growth mechanisms that continuously improve customer outcomes and business performance.

Stay ahead of evolving SaaS, AI, and customer trends, translating market insights and customer needs into differentiated product experiences and growth opportunities.

Own the Voice of the Customer through customer interviews, behavioral analytics, retention analysis, and segmentation research, translating insights into product strategy and roadmap priorities.

Influence and align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Revenue, and Customer Success to drive coordinated execution and measurable business impact.

Mentor Product Managers and contribute to product management best practices, growth methodologies, and experimentation culture across the organization.

Requirements
10+ years of Product Management experience with a proven track record of driving product growth and business outcomes.

Strong experience building and scaling SaaS products, with deep expertise in onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, and product-led growth.

Experience owning a product area and delivering measurable improvements in customer engagement, retention, and revenue performance.

Strong understanding of SaaS growth metrics, experimentation frameworks, customer lifecycle management, and KPI-driven product strategies.

Experience partnering with Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering teams to build measurement frameworks, customer health models, and growth insights.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable product decisions.

Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority.

Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

Nice-to-Have
Experience with reseller platforms, white-label SaaS products, partner ecosystems, or agency-focused software.

Experience serving agencies, SMBs, or platform businesses.

Familiarity with recurring revenue models, subscription businesses, and SaaS monetization strategies.

Experience building customer journey analytics, growth dashboards, and experimentation platforms.

Experience operating in high-scale SaaS environments.

What You'll GetStrategic Impact
Opportunity to own one of HighLevel's most strategic growth areas and shape the future of the Agency Revenue Suite.

Direct ownership of growth outcomes across SaaS Mode, Reselling, Rebilling, and agency monetization experiences.

Collaborative Culture
Work alongside exceptional teammates across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Revenue, and Customer Success.

Partner closely with analytics, growth, and customer-facing teams to solve complex business challenges.

Scale
Influence how thousands of agencies build and grow recurring revenue businesses on HighLevel.

Define the growth metrics, experimentation frameworks, and success models that power the next phase of platform growth.

Build products and experiences that impact millions of businesses globally.

Why Join HighLevel?At HighLevel, you'll have the opportunity to define and scale one of the company's most important growth initiatives. You'll help shape how agencies build recurring revenue businesses while creating durable growth systems that drive long-term customer and business success.

Role Overview
HighLevel is accelerating its Email Marketing platform to become the AI-first communication engine for businesses worldwide. We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to transform Email Marketing from a traditional campaign builder into an intelligent, end-to-end campaign creation and automation ecosystem.
Today, HighLevel powers email creation, campaign scheduling, reporting, and lifecycle automation through Email Builder and Sequences. Your mandate is to redefine the customer experience through AI-native creation, intuitive editing interfaces, intelligent lifecycle automation, and actionable campaign intelligence — driving user adoption, activation, engagement, and revenue with a clear, metrics-driven product roadmap.


Key Responsibilities
1. Build World-Class Email Creation Experiences
Own the end-to-end Email Builder user experience, including drag-and-drop editors, custom HTML tools, reusable visual components, responsive templates, and real-time collaborative editing.
Build an industry-leading AI-native email editor that enables users to generate complete, high-converting email layouts using simple natural language prompts.
Lead the evolution of a natural language prompt-to-layout generation ("vibe-code") builder, allowing non-technical marketers to create production-ready emails instantaneously.
Deliver native multivariate experimentation tools, including subject line, body copy, layout, and Call-To-Action (CTA) A/B testing to continuously improve conversion rates.
2. Transform Email Marketing Through AI
Define the multi-year vision and execution strategy for Email AI, enabling automated campaign generation, brand-aware messaging, localized/multilingual copy creation, and intelligent optimization.
Build Sequence AI to automatically create multi-step lifecycle journeys, including onboarding, lead nurture, abandoned cart recovery, upsells, and re-engagement campaigns.
Partner closely with core AI teams to deliver prompt-based workflow creation, predictive recommendations, and autonomous campaign creation.
Maintain high standards for responsible AI, establishing guardrails around brand voice consistency, content quality evaluation, and privacy compliance.
3. Build Intelligent Campaign Delivery & Automation Workflows
Own execution and scheduling features, including Send Now, Scheduled Send, Timezone-aware Sending, and AI-powered Send Time Optimization.
Scale automated Sequences, trigger logic, dynamic branching, smart personalization fields, and event-driven marketing workflows.
Streamline campaign creation workflows to minimize operational complexity for marketers while maximizing end-user engagement.
4. Drive Campaign Intelligence & Customer Insights
Build reporting dashboards that accurately measure campaign execution, open/click engagement, conversion rates, attributed revenue, and overall ROI.
Deliver actionable, AI-powered recommendations that guide users on how to improve campaign engagement and conversion performance.
Establish robust product instrumentation, funnels, and experimentation frameworks to measure feature adoption and product-led outcomes.
5. Build Audience & Preference Management
Own subscriber preferences, consent management workflows, and end-user preference centers.
Deliver flexible preference experiences that increase customer trust and support global messaging compliance (CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR, etc.).
6. Drive Product Strategy & Execution
Establish a 12–18 month product roadmap for Email Marketing aligned with HighLevel’s broader product strategy.
Conduct continuous customer discovery, competitive analysis, and usability research.
Author clear, outcome-focused PRDs and partner closely with Engineering, Product Design, AI, Customer Success, and Go-To-Market teams.
What Success Looks Like
First 90 Days
Formulate a strategic vision and roadmap for the Email Builder and AI-powered campaign lifecycle.
Identify and ship initial usability and performance quick-wins in the core Email Builder and Sequence tools based on user feedback and analytics.
Establish clear instrumentation and North Star KPIs around activation, campaign creation velocity, and engagement.
Align cross-functional Engineering, Design, AI, and GTM teams on upcoming priorities.
First 12 Months
Launch Email AI into General Availability (GA) with strong user adoption, drastically reducing campaign creation time.
Deploy production-ready natural language prompt-to-layout email generation capabilities.
Ship Sequence AI, enabling users to generate multi-touch customer journeys using simple prompts.
Expand preference management tools to ensure global compliance and improved subscriber trust.
Drive measurable uplift in activation, feature adoption, and campaign success across the HighLevel ecosystem.
Requirements
8+ years of Product Management experience, with a background in SaaS product management, email marketing tools, WYSIWYG builders, or marketing automation platforms.
Demonstrated success building intuitive, high-adoption end-user tools (editors, drag-and-drop builders, visual canvas tools, or content creation interfaces).
Hands-on experience with AI/ML integrations, particularly generative text/image tools, prompt engineering workflows, or predictive optimization engines.
Strong product craft: proven track record of writing PRDs, mapping user journeys, conducting customer research, and translating complex capabilities into simple UX.
Data-fluent mindset: experience defining product instrumentation, running A/B tests, and tracking funnel conversion metrics.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Design, Product, and GTM teams.
Nice-to-Have
Experience with marketing automation workflows, drip campaigns, or lifecycle marketing tools.
Background in dynamic content generation, templating systems, or visual design software.
Experience designing features for international audiences (localization, multi-language support).

Role Overview:As the Staff Product Manager for HardPhones, SIP, IVR, and Call Center, you will own the strategy, execution, and architectural evolution of HighLevel's enterprise voice and contact center infrastructure. You will lead the products and platforms that power SIP communications, physical IP phones, IVR experiences, voice routing, our multi-provider communications middleware, and native Call Center (CCaaS) features.

You will define the roadmap for building a carrier-agnostic voice platform that enables reliable, scalable, and intelligent voice communications across multiple CPaaS providers. Crucially, this scope extends into Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS). You will architect and scale our native Call Center features, developing sophisticated routing logic, agent workspaces, and queue management systems.

This role sits at the intersection of communications infrastructure, telecom engineering, voice automation, contact center operations, and platform scale. You will partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Product, Support, and external communication providers to build the next generation of HighLevel's voice platform.

Key Responsibilities:
Own the vision, strategy and execution for HighLevel's HardPhone, SIP, IVR, Call Center and Enterprise Voice platforms.
Build a scalable, provider-agnostic communications platform that abstracts multiple CPaaS providers through a unified architecture.
Architect and scale sophisticated Automatic Call Distributor (ACD) capabilities, including skills-based routing, priority queues, ring groups, overflow rules, business hours and failover logic.
Design intuitive softphone experiences across web and mobile, along with real-time supervisor dashboards for monitoring, coaching and workforce management.
Own the complete lifecycle of HardPhone provisioning, including Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP), remote configuration, firmware management, inventory management and device lifecycle operations.
Drive the evolution of IVR and Voice AI, including drag-and-drop workflow builders, conversational AI, speech recognition, call transcription, agent assistance, and call summarization.
Build enterprise telephony capabilities including call recording, voicemail, conferencing, whisper/barge, monitoring, queue management and compliance recording.
Define extensible Voice APIs, SDKs, webhooks and event frameworks that enable seamless integrations with third-party applications and ecosystem partners.
Lead customer migration initiatives, including provider migrations, number portability, hosted phone onboarding, and enterprise telephony transitions, while minimizing customer disruption.
Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, Support and Go-to-Market teams to deliver highly reliable, globally scalable voice products.
Establish and monitor platform KPIs including call completion rates, SIP reliability, provisioning success, IVR containment, routing efficiency, call quality (MOS), queue abandonment, agent utilization, billing accuracy, platform availability and customer satisfaction (CSAT).
Develop and execute the long-term roadmap for enterprise telephony, AI-powered communications, multi-vendor architecture and next-generation voice experiences, ensuring HighLevel maintains competitive parity and platform leadership.
Requirement:
8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of communications, telecommunications, voice infrastructure, CPaaS, CCaaS or enterprise platform products.
Deep understanding of SIP, RTP, WebRTC, VoIP, IVR, enterprise telephony, and contact center ecosystems.
Proven experience building communications infrastructure or voice platform products at scale, including Automatic Call Distributor (ACD), intelligent routing and Call Center functionality.
Strong understanding of SIP endpoint management, HardPhone provisioning, remote device management, and telephony lifecycle management.
Experience working directly with CPaaS providers, telecom operators, hardware vendors, or communications infrastructure platforms.
Experience building multi-provider routing, abstraction layers, middleware, or API-first platform products.
Experience designing scalable multi-tenant platforms and highly available distributed systems serving enterprise customers.
Strong understanding of intelligent routing, least-cost routing (LCR), provider redundancy, failover mechanisms, and global telephony architecture.
Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills, with experience defining platform KPIs and using analytics to drive product strategy.
Demonstrated ability to define long-term platform strategy, influence executive stakeholders, and lead cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Infrastructure, Finance, Operations, and Go-to-Market teams.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.
Nice-to-Have:
Familiarity with SIP infrastructure technologies.
Experience building conversational AI, speech recognition, voice automation, AI-powered call routing or agent assist capabilities.
Familiarity with STIR/SHAKEN, CNAM, E911, number portability, hosted numbers (BYOC/BYON), and regulatory compliance across global telephony markets.
Experience building contact center (CCaaS) capabilities such as workforce management, quality monitoring, call recording, coaching, and supervisor tools.
Experience working with event-driven architectures, APIs, SDKs, and developer platforms for communications products.
Understanding of enterprise security, privacy, and compliance requirements for voice platforms, including GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or similar standards.
Core KPIs:
Voice Platform Reliability – SIP session success rate, call completion rate, provider failover success.
Call Center Efficiency – Queue Abandonment Rate, Average Handle Time (AHT), Agent Utilization.
HardPhone Provisioning – Device onboarding success rate, provisioning time, firmware deployment success.
IVR Performance – IVR containment rate, workflow completion, conversational AI adoption.
Routing Efficiency – Least-cost routing optimization, latency reduction, provider utilization.
Why Join HighLevel?At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company. Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

About us

Our people

We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the team
The Product team is responsible for driving lead generation and management of leads. We do this by building innovative products & features that solve real-world problems for agencies and allow them to consolidate their offering to their clients in a single platform packaged under their white-labled brand. 

The marketing products OS team focuses exclusively on products that can demonstrate lead generation and drive up engagement, adoption in target segments. This team handles multiple product areas including Social Planner, Ad Manager, Reputation and Rewiew AI, Affiliate manager, Loyalty and Rewards, Template Library, Brand Boards.

HighLevel is an exciting place to work as it gives adrenaline to build and help our user base.   
We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users
It’s never somebody else’s job - Take ownership as a company owner
We are passionately focussed on adding value for our users
We deliver fast using lean principles (Agile framework). We go to market in weeks instead of quarters
A good innovative idea always gets tested and we deliver based on feedbacks
We embrace that improvement is constant and iterative.
Constant Learning Growth graph - You will learn how to scale B2B SaaS Startup and build relevant, impactful products for customers
We are do-ers and go-getters to achieve team adoptions.

The Role
We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Social Planner. Grow our value metric numbers from 30M to 90M published posts with the goal of focusing on adoption, activation and retention metrics. 

You’ll be responsible for turning a strong product vision into reality, driving meaningful business and customer impact, and leveling up the product team around you. You’ll directly mentor and grow a team of PMs into solid Senior Product Managers while partnering closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and GTM.

This is a highly strategic, high-impact role for someone who can think in systems, ship fast with quality, and raise the bar for product management across the organization.

What You’ll Own

1. Product Strategy & Vision
Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for Social Planner.
Translate company and product vision into clear north-star metrics, long-term bets, and a sequenced 12–18 month roadmap.
Identify and validate the most impactful problems to solve for our core customers (agencies, marketers, SMBs, etc.).
2. Social Planner – UI/UX Excellence & Competitive Parity
Own Social Planner as a core flagship experience that can compete with other tools
Lead major improvements across: 
UI & workflows (scheduling, approvals, calendar, collaboration, automations, comment management).
Statistics & reporting (post performance, account-level insights, content analytics).
Controls for owners (permissions, approvals, governance, workspace controls).
Partner with Design to deliver a clean, intuitive, and scalable UX, and ensure high-quality execution with Engineering.
3. Execution, Delivery & Cross-Functional Leadership
Turn strategy into clear, prioritized roadmaps, well-defined problem statements, and detailed specs where needed.
Run discovery (customer interviews, data analysis, experiments) to validate problems and solutions.
Partner with Engineering to plan releases, manage scope, and ensure predictable and high-quality delivery.
Work closely with Marketing, Sales, Support, and Customer Success to: 
Shape positioning, messaging, and GTM plans.
Enable internal teams with the right documentation and training.
Incorporate market/field feedback quickly into the roadmap.
4. Mentorship & Team Development
Directly mentor and grow two APMs into strong PM2s, with clear expectations, coaching, and feedback.
Build a culture of data-informed, customer-obsessed, outcome-driven product management.
Lead by example on craft: PRDs, problem framing, stakeholder management, and prioritization.
Evangelize best practices around experimentation, discovery, and continuous improvement.
What You’ll Bring
9+ years of experience in Product Management, with at least 3+ years at Senior/Staff/Principal level owning complex product areas.
Proven track record of shipping impactful products in B2B SaaS, ideally in: 
Marketing automation
Social media management
Strong technical aptitude: 
Understanding of APIs, data flows, and system design at a conceptual level.
Experience working with data/ML/AI-driven products is a strong plus.
Deep experience with discovery and experimentation: Defining metrics, running A/B tests, analyzing usage data, and validating hypotheses.
Demonstrated ability to rebuild or significantly revamp complex UX flows (dashboards, editors, planners, calendars, etc.).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments with multiple priorities.
What Success Looks Like (6–12 Months)

Within your first year, you will have: 
Delivered a clear, aligned 12–18 month roadmap for Social Planner.
Shipped high-impact improvements that upgrade Social Planner UX and capabilities to be competitive with leading social tools like Hootesuite, Buffer, Publer.
Improved key metrics (usage, retention, satisfaction) across your product area.
Earned a reputation as a go-to strategic leader who can connect dots across teams and drive big, meaningful outcomes.

EEO Statement
The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the team
The Product team is responsible for driving lead generation and management of leads. We do this by building innovative products & features that solve real-world problems for agencies and allow them to consolidate their offering to their clients in a single platform packaged under their white-labled brand. 

The marketing products OS team focuses exclusively on products that can demonstrate lead generation and drive up engagement, adoption in target segments. This team handles multiple product areas including Social Planner, Ad Manager, Reputation and Rewiew AI, Affiliate manager, Loyalty and Rewards, Template Library, Brand Boards.

HighLevel is an exciting place to work as it gives adrenaline to build and help our user base.  
  • We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users
  • It’s never somebody else’s job - Take ownership as a company owner
  • We are passionately focussed on adding value for our users
  • We deliver fast using lean principles (Agile framework). We go to market in weeks instead of quarters
  • A good innovative idea always gets tested and we deliver based on feedbacks
  • We embrace that improvement is constant and iterative.
  • Constant Learning Growth graph - You will learn how to scale B2B SaaS Startup and build relevant, impactful products for customers
  • We are do-ers and go-getters to achieve team adoptions.

The Role
We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Social Planner. Grow our value metric numbers from 30M to 90M published posts with the goal of focusing on adoption, activation and retention metrics. 

You’ll be responsible for turning a strong product vision into reality, driving meaningful business and customer impact, and leveling up the product team around you. You’ll directly mentor and grow a team of PMs into solid Senior Product Managers while partnering closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and GTM.

This is a highly strategic, high-impact role for someone who can think in systems, ship fast with quality, and raise the bar for product management across the organization.

What You’ll Own

1. Product Strategy & Vision
  • Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for Social Planner.
  • Translate company and product vision into clear north-star metrics, long-term bets, and a sequenced 12–18 month roadmap.
  • Identify and validate the most impactful problems to solve for our core customers (agencies, marketers, SMBs, etc.).
2. Social Planner – UI/UX Excellence & Competitive Parity
  • Own Social Planner as a core flagship experience that can compete with other tools
  • Lead major improvements across:
    • UI & workflows (scheduling, approvals, calendar, collaboration, automations, comment management).
    • Statistics & reporting (post performance, account-level insights, content analytics).
    • Controls for owners (permissions, approvals, governance, workspace controls).
  • Partner with Design to deliver a clean, intuitive, and scalable UX, and ensure high-quality execution with Engineering.
3. Execution, Delivery & Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Turn strategy into clear, prioritized roadmaps, well-defined problem statements, and detailed specs where needed.
  • Run discovery (customer interviews, data analysis, experiments) to validate problems and solutions.
  • Partner with Engineering to plan releases, manage scope, and ensure predictable and high-quality delivery.
  • Work closely with Marketing, Sales, Support, and Customer Success to:
    • Shape positioning, messaging, and GTM plans.
    • Enable internal teams with the right documentation and training.
    • Incorporate market/field feedback quickly into the roadmap.
4. Mentorship & Team Development
  • Directly mentor and grow two APMs into strong PM2s, with clear expectations, coaching, and feedback.
  • Build a culture of data-informed, customer-obsessed, outcome-driven product management.
  • Lead by example on craft: PRDs, problem framing, stakeholder management, and prioritization.
  • Evangelize best practices around experimentation, discovery, and continuous improvement.
What You’ll Bring
  • 9+ years of experience in Product Management, with at least 3+ years at Senior/Staff/Principal level owning complex product areas.
  • Proven track record of shipping impactful products in B2B SaaS, ideally in:
    • Marketing automation
    • Social media management
  • Strong technical aptitude:
    • Understanding of APIs, data flows, and system design at a conceptual level.
    • Experience working with data/ML/AI-driven products is a strong plus.
  • Deep experience with discovery and experimentation: Defining metrics, running A/B tests, analyzing usage data, and validating hypotheses.
  • Demonstrated ability to rebuild or significantly revamp complex UX flows (dashboards, editors, planners, calendars, etc.).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments with multiple priorities.
What Success Looks Like (6–12 Months)

Within your first year, you will have:
  • Delivered a clear, aligned 12–18 month roadmap for Social Planner.
  • Shipped high-impact improvements that upgrade Social Planner UX and capabilities to be competitive with leading social tools like Hootesuite, Buffer, Publer.
  • Improved key metrics (usage, retention, satisfaction) across your product area.
  • Earned a reputation as a go-to strategic leader who can connect dots across teams and drive big, meaningful outcomes.

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

Role OverviewFor SMBs worldwide, WhatsApp is increasingly the primary way customers reach a business, ahead of email, SMS, and the phone. HighLevel's WhatsApp product is already our highest-volume conversational channel, carrying over 171 million messages a month for 58.5K businesses, and it accounts for 44% of every Conversation AI conversation on the platform.

As the Staff Product Manager for WhatsApp, you will own the strategy, execution, and quality bar for that product end to end: onboarding and Coexistence, templates, WhatsApp Flows, WhatsApp Calling on WebRTC, Conversation AI and Voice AI, and the credit-line and usage-billing systems that monetize it. You will define the roadmap for a reliable, self-serve platform that abstracts Meta's Business Platform for non-technical agency operators, at a scale where a single Meta policy change or quality-rating downgrade is a revenue event.

This is a hands-on, technically fluent IC product leadership role. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Finance, Support, Go-to-Market, and Meta's own product and solutions engineering teams, and be expected to prototype your own ideas, run your own customer calls, and hold your own in a technical review. This is not a channel-integration role. It is for someone who can build a reliable, compliant, commercially meaningful product on top of a platform we do not control.

Key Responsibilities
Define and drive the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for HighLevel WhatsApp across onboarding, templates, Flows, Calling, AI, and monetization, and make explicit calls on where not to invest.
Make onboarding self-serve and fast, covering embedded signup, number and business verification, multi-WABA, and Coexistence, now the majority of new onboardings.
Own deliverability and account health, including quality rating, messaging-limit tiers, and the failure taxonomy behind every undelivered message, made legible to a non-technical operator before a campaign fails.
Own the template lifecycle, covering categories, approvals and rejections, quality-based pausing, rich formats, localization, and a pre-approved library that collapses time-to-first-message.
Own WhatsApp Calling on WebRTC end to end, including the softphone experience, call permissions, recording, transcripts, and the call-quality instrumentation Meta does not provide.
Own WhatsApp Flows, including Flow JSON authoring, endpoint-backed data exchange, per-WABA encryption key management, and the publishing lifecycle.
Drive Conversation AI, WhatsApp bots, and Voice AI on the channel, covering engagement and handoff rules, guardrails, language coverage, and per-conversation cost metering so AI stays margin-positive.
Own monetization, including subscription and usage pricing, per-currency credit lines and migrations, wallet debit accuracy, reselling markups, and discount programs such as Marketing Messages Lite.
Work Meta directly as a platform partner to secure private betas and pre-release access, escalate policy and account issues for customers, influence their roadmap, and own partner-funded development programs through claim execution.
Prototype to de-risk scope, run your own customer discovery, and partner with design on the highest-friction surfaces such as onboarding, template authoring, and Flows.
Partner with Product Marketing, Support, Implementation, RevEx, and Finance to drive activation, retention, packaging, and revenue, and to reduce support volume.
Lead breaking platform migrations across the live installed base, such as WhatsApp Business unique identifiers and usernames, with a clear migration and communication plan.

Ideal Candidate Profile
8+ years of product management experience owning complex B2B SaaS, messaging, communications, AI, automation, CRM, or platform products, including a senior IC role such as Staff, Principal, or Lead PM.
Deep understanding of the WhatsApp Business Platform, or strong fluency in an adjacent messaging, CPaaS or BSP, conversational AI, or telephony domain.
Working knowledge of real-time voice, including WebRTC and VoIP call quality, enough to reason about why calls drop and what to instrument when the provider exposes no metrics.
Technical enough to work credibly with engineering on APIs and webhooks, LLM behavior, rate limits and retries, observability, and scalability.
Comfort operating on top of a third-party platform you do not control, where the provider's policies and approval queues directly gate your customers.
Strong grasp of usage-based monetization, including rate cards, margin mechanics, wallet and credit-line architecture, and billing accuracy.
Hands-on prototyping ability, and a habit of running your own customer interviews rather than consuming someone else's summary.
Strong analytical ability. Can define metrics, write your own SQL, diagnose funnel drop-offs, and separate noisy feedback from real problems.
Experience in high-growth international markets, particularly LatAm, India, or SEA.
Excellent written communication and high ownership in a fast-growth, remote-first environment.

Bonus Points For
Hands-on experience with Cloud API, Marketing Messages Lite, embedded signup, or WABA operations, or time at a BSP, tech provider, or messaging aggregator.
Experience with WebRTC, SIP, call recording, number provisioning, or telecom compliance.
Experience building AI agents, voice bots, or virtual receptionists, including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and LLM orchestration.
Experience with content-approval or moderation pipelines where a third party gates what your customers can send.
Experience with usage-based pricing, multi-currency billing, or credit lines.
Experience shipping breaking platform changes across a large live installed base.

Why Join HighLevel?At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company. 
Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.


EEO StatementThe company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for HighLevel WhatsApp across onboarding, templates, Flows, Calling, AI, and monetization, and make explicit calls on where not to invest.

  • Own deliverability and account health, including quality rating, messaging-limit tiers, and the failure taxonomy behind every undelivered message, made legible to a non-technical operator before a campaign fails.
  • Own the template lifecycle, covering categories, approvals and rejections, quality-based pausing, rich formats, localization, and a pre-approved library that collapses time-to-first-message.
  • Own WhatsApp Calling on WebRTC end to end, including the softphone experience, call permissions, recording, transcripts, and the call-quality instrumentation Meta does not provide.
  • Own WhatsApp Flows, including Flow JSON authoring, endpoint-backed data exchange, per-WABA encryption key management, and the publishing lifecycle.
  • Drive Conversation AI, WhatsApp bots, and Voice AI on the channel, covering engagement and handoff rules, guardrails, language coverage, and per-conversation cost metering so AI stays margin-positive.
  • Own monetization, including subscription and usage pricing, per-currency credit lines and migrations, wallet debit accuracy, reselling markups, and discount programs such as Marketing Messages Lite.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  • 8+ years of product management experience owning complex B2B SaaS, messaging, communications, AI, automation, CRM, or platform products, including a senior IC role such as Staff, Principal, or Lead PM.

  • Working knowledge of real-time voice, including WebRTC and VoIP call quality, enough to reason about why calls drop and what to instrument when the provider exposes no metrics.

  • Comfort operating on top of a third-party platform you do not control, where the provider's policies and approval queues directly gate your customers.
  • Strong grasp of usage-based monetization, including rate cards, margin mechanics, wallet and credit-line architecture, and billing accuracy.
  • Hands-on prototyping ability, and a habit of running your own customer interviews rather than consuming someone else's summary.
  • Strong analytical ability. Can define metrics, write your own SQL, diagnose funnel drop-offs, and separate noisy feedback from real problems.
  • Experience in high-growth international markets, particularly LatAm, India, or SEA.
  • Excellent written communication and high ownership in a fast-growth, remote-first environment.

  • Hands-on experience with Cloud API, Marketing Messages Lite, embedded signup, or WABA operations, or time at a BSP, tech provider, or messaging aggregator.

Role Overview:As the Staff Product Manager for Agency Monetization & Wallet, you will own the strategy and execution of HighLevel’s Reselling, Rebilling, and Wallet experiences for agencies and subaccounts.

You will be responsible for how agencies recover platform costs, apply markups, resell HighLevel products, manage funds, and understand the movement of money across their accounts and customers.

This role sits at the intersection of monetization, billing, payments infrastructure, and agency operations. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Finance, Revenue Operations, Tax, and product teams across HighLevel to build a reliable and scalable system that enables agencies to monetize HighLevel products while maintaining financial accuracy, transparency, and control.

Your work will shape how agencies and subaccounts transact across HighLevel—from wallet funding and usage deductions to rebilling, markups, taxes, credits, and profitability visibility. 
Key Responsibilities
Own the product strategy and roadmap for HighLevel's Reselling, Rebilling, and Wallet platform.
Identify customer problems and market opportunities to improve how agencies monetize HighLevel products and manage financial operations.
Lead product initiatives from discovery through execution, balancing customer needs, technical complexity, and business objectives.
Partner closely with Engineering and Design to build scalable, reliable, and intuitive platform experiences.
Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and other Product teams to ensure seamless end-to-end monetization workflows.
Define success metrics, leverage customer insights and data, and continuously optimize product performance.
Drive alignment across stakeholders while influencing product direction across multiple teams.
Mentor Product Managers and contribute to raising the overall product management bar across the organization.

Reselling Platform
Rebilling Platform
Agency Wallet
Subaccount Wallet
Wallet Funding & Auto Recharge
Transaction History & Financial Transparency
Credits, Refunds & Adjustments
Markups & Margin Management
Agency Tax Experience
Wallet APIs & Platform Services
Monetization Frameworks consumed by product teams

Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for HighLevel's Reselling, Rebilling, and Wallet products.
Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from customer discovery and strategy through execution, launch, and continuous improvement.
Build products that simplify how agencies monetize HighLevel, manage billing workflows, and operate their businesses.
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Finance, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and other Product teams to deliver scalable, customer-centric solutions.
Drive product decisions by leveraging customer research, market insights, experimentation, and data.
Balance customer needs, business objectives, technical complexity, and platform scalability to deliver high-impact outcomes.
Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and continuously improve customer experience through data-driven iteration.
Influence product direction across multiple teams and align stakeholders around a shared product vision.
Mentor Product Managers and contribute to strengthening product strategy, execution, and product management best practices across the organization.

Requirement:
8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of complex financial or payments infrastructure in SaaS or fintech environments.
Proven ability to design, ship, and scale systems that handle large volumes of financial transactions and reconciliations.
Deep understanding of Stripe’s ecosystem — including Connected Accounts, Treasury, Payment Intents, Tax APIs, and reconciliation workflows.
Strong grasp of global payments, multi-currency management, and FX settlement across regions (US, EU, Canada, India, Australia).
Experience implementing or integrating tax compliance systems (e.g., Stripe Tax, Avalara, or internal frameworks) for B2B and reseller transactions.
Demonstrated ability to work across finance, tax, and engineering teams to ensure accounting accuracy and regulatory alignment.
High comfort with hands-on execution — including data validation, variance analysis, and mapping product usage to revenue.
Analytical mindset with experience using SQL, BI tools, or financial data models to diagnose issues and validate hypotheses.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial concepts for cross-functional audiences.
Track record of driving measurable impact through systemic improvements, automation, and data-driven decisions.

Nice-to-Have
Prior experience building or managing usage-based billing or embedded finance platforms.
Familiarity with accounting systems (NetSuite, Chargebee, QuickBooks) and their integration with payment data pipelines.
Understanding of reseller ecosystems, margin management, and agency billing workflows.
Experience with cross-border compliance and digital goods taxation (VAT, GST, HST).
Exposure to financial ledger design, double-entry accounting models, or journal reconciliation automation.
Strong technical fluency with APIs, data pipelines, and internal tools related to payments and finance.
Background in high-scale SaaS or fintech environments (e.g., Stripe, Shopify, Adyen, PayPal, or B2B billing systems).
Experience operating in remote, global teams with complex stakeholder alignment across functions and time zones.
